title: Principal Analyst, BI Service Delivery
description:
**Principal Analyst, Business Intelligence Service Delivery:**
This role is responsible for leading development and support for the analytics solutions on SAP BW, Azure, Databricks, PBI and BPC. This individual is responsible for leading the business requirement gathering, design technical solutions, implementation, and optimization of solutions.
  
  
This role combines technical expertise with business acumen to ensure efficient and effective IT solutions delivery for analytics operations and automation.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgement in applying professional expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision. This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.
  
  
This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.
* Provide technical leadership to internal and vendor development teams, including solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, implementation, troubleshooting, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Drive operational excellence by overseeing day-to-day application support and maintenance while identifying opportunities to improve system performance, process efficiency, and overall customer experience.
* Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, resolving complex technical issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve application stability and service reliability.
* Transform support operations through automation, AI, self-service, and shift-left approaches, reducing manual effort and continuously improving service effectiveness and user experience.
* Own service excellence and continuous improvement, establishing service roadmaps, proactive monitoring, support procedures, and improvement initiatives based on stakeholder demand and customer feedback.
* Manage onshore/offshore teams and technology vendors, monitoring performance against agreed service expectations and driving accountability for high-quality development, support, and service delivery.
* Ensure strong governance and operational readiness through adherence to release management processes and maintenance of accurate system documentation, requirements, test scripts, knowledge articles, configuration information, and support procedures.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in data and analytics, including designing and developing scalable, high-quality solutions across SAP BW and Microsoft Azure platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BW, Databricks, Power BI, Azure Data Factory (ADF) and ETL technologies such as Informatica; SAP BW certification preferred.
* Strong production/application support experience, with strong capabilities in Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management, including root cause analysis and systematic troubleshooting.
* Proven experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and solutions, covering architecture, data flows, design, development, testing, documentation, deployment, and enhancements.
* Strong understanding of ITIL, SDLC, Agile, and Waterfall methodologies; ITIL Foundation v4 or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience designing and supporting cross-application integrations involving SAP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms, along with exposure to AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal/external relationships and simplify complex technical concepts into actionable plans; MedTech industry experience preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

description:
****Company Overview****
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
  
  
****Department Overview****
Company Overview:
  
  
At Motorola Solutions, we create technologies our customers refer to as their lifeline. Our technology platforms in communications, software, video and services help our customers work safely and more efficiently. Whether it’s helping firefighters see through smoke, enabling police officers to see around street corners, or reliably keeping the lights on in homes and businesses around the world, our work supports those who put their lives on the line to keep us safe. Bring your passion, potential and talent to Motorola Solutions, and help us usher in a new era in public safety and security.
  
  
**Department Overview:**
Our IT organization has a critical role in driving extraordinary business results. Through a strong partnership with other areas of our business, we bring innovative thinking to every conversation and deliver with integrity. We’re looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners’ ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it.
  
  
**Job Description**
Within the Digital Program at MSI IT, we’re passionate about building software that solves problems. We count on our Sr. Database Development Lead (DDLs) to empower our users with a rich feature set, high availability, and stellar performance level to pursue their missions. As we expand our customer deployments, we are currently seeking a DDL to understand our IT systems and applications data requirements and help build new applications or enhance existing applications databases. Specifically, we are searching for someone who brings fresh ideas, demonstrates a unique and informed viewpoint, and enjoys collaborating with a cross-functional team to develop real-world solutions and positive user experiences at every interaction. As a DDL, you will be responsible for business and IT stakeholders interaction, requirements analysis, designing the systems, lead the development efforts and of the Digital Transformation platform & help us meet the business requirements, enrich the customer experience and satisfaction and improve the quality and integrity of the software applications and associated data.
  
  
****Objectives Of This Role:****

* Interact with various IT and business stakeholders, teams to understand various applications and data flow.
* Identify business and IT needs and translate them into the technical and functional requirements.
* Develop software and systems to manage platform infrastructure and applications data
* Improve reliability, quality, and time-to-market of our suite of software solutions and associated data.
* Measure and optimize system performance, with an eye toward pushing our capabilities forward, getting ahead of customer needs, and innovating for continuous improvement
* Provide support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications and databases.
* Keep applications, software, hardware and databases up to date.

****Daily And Monthly Responsibilities****

* Partner with development teams to deliver the planned deliverables
* Meet with IT leaders to discuss project goals, solution quality, schedule and progress, and the overall client relationship.
* Estimate the work required to implement a module of a project and its data needs.
* Test your work and review team members’ work and give constructive feedback on improvements.
* Serve as the technical lead on multiple active project initiatives.
* Assist in the creation of design documents and key artifacts for the project.
* Leverage internal tools, standards, and processes for the development work.
* Help peers and junior team members debug code or resolve technical problems.
* Drive client satisfaction through repeated project delivery successes and strategic engagement.

****Additional Accountabilities:****

* Complex Issue Triage (Across multiple technology platforms and vendors)
* Database performance improvement and data cleanup
* Establish best practices for performance and stability
* Conduct monthly reviews to review trends and change recommendations
* Review and maintain list of corrective actions

Basic Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or other highly technical, scientific discipline.
* 9+ years of software development experience using PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, SQL Server, MySQL databases.
* Extensive RDBMS database working knowledge on DDL, DML SQLs, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, views development in various databases.
* A proactive approach to spotting problems, areas for improvement, and performance bottlenecks.
* Expertise in various DB administration and development tools such as Oracle SQL Developer, SQL Workbench, Oracle Toad, SQL Plus, pgAdmin4, Flyway, and DBeaver.
* Experience in developing, testing/debugging database scripts/jobs in e-Commerce, Services, finance, billing and payment, user and account management, insurance, banking domains.
* Experience in developing, testing/debugging various database objects.
* Hands-on experience of database migrations and upgrades.
* Familiarity with responsive design/development best practices.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
* Good written and oral communication skills.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS.
* Exposure to lead the software development team and mentor them to build a high performing team.
* Should be able to manage work independently.
* Must be familiar with various types of testing, defect prevention activities & Quality Management.
* Hands-on experience in various AI tools like GH Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Cursor, etc.
* Well aware of CI/CD processes and having experience using DevOps tools like Bitbucket, Jenkins, Jira, Git, Confluence, version control, etc.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.
  
  
Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.
  
  
Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.
  
  
**About Sarvam**
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
  
  
****What this role promises you****
You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.
  
  
****What you'll do****

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.
  
  
****Who you are****
We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.
  
  

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

****Bonus points****

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: SQL Database Engineer
description:

With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the world's most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.
  
  
The SQL Database Engineer II is responsible for extracting, transforming, and validating clinical and administrative data from ambulatory EHR/EMR systems to support CMS MIPS and Value-Based Care reporting. The role requires strong expertise in SQL, HL7, CCDA, FHIR, EDI 837/835, EMR database schemas, and data pipeline engineering to ensure accurate, secure, and audit-ready regulatory submissions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Interpret HL7 segments (PID, PV1, ORC, OBR, OBX, DG1, RXA, etc.) for clinical measure mapping.
* Troubleshoot inconsistent or malformed HL7 messages and resolve data quality gaps with vendors.
* Build robust parsing logic to normalize data across heterogeneous EMR systems.

**EMR/EHR Database Querying & Measure Data Retrieval**

* HL7 Parsing & Clinical Data Interpretation.

* Analytical & Critical Thinking Skills.
* Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration.
* Quality Assurance & Data Governance.
* Cloud Engineering & Modern Data Stack Proficiency.
* Diligence & Regulatory Mindset.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years in data engineering, healthcare data extraction, or clinical informatics.
* Deep expertise with SQL, Python, Spark (batch + streaming) on Databricks, EMR, or DataFlow.
* Strong experience with HL7 v2.x, CCDA, FHIR, EDI X12 (837/835).
* Proven ability to query and interpret ambulatory EMR/EHR schemas (NextGen, eCW, Greenway, etc.).
* Hands-on optimization experience with Autonomous Data Warehouse, Snowflake, or Redshift.

* Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

title: Database Administrator Senior - Postgres - MySQL
description:
The Senior Database Administrator is responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and support of Experity’s cloud-native database platforms, focusing primarily on Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL running on AWS RDS.
  
  
This role plays a critical part in ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and security of mission-critical SaaS databases. The DBA partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to operate a highly observable, resilient, and cost-efficient data platform.
  
  
This role is expected to act as a technical leader in database reliability and performance, influencing architecture decisions, mentoring team members, and driving operational excellence across multiple database platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and manage PostgreSQL and MySQL databases in AWS RDS and Aurora environments.
* Configure and manage MySQL parameter groups, option groups, automated backups, snapshots, and maintenance windows.
* Architect and support high availability solutions leveraging clusters, read replicas, Multi-AZ deployments, writer/reader endpoint strategies and read scaling.
* Monitor and mitigate replication lag across replicas to ensure read consistency and performance.
* Tune and manage database-specific parameters.
* Optimize workloads for Aurora storage architecture, including I/O patterns, autovacuum behavior, and checkpoint tuning.
* Optimize database indexing, query execution plans, and MySQL InnoDB configuration for production workloads
* Monitor and troubleshoot database performance using AWS CloudWatch, DataDog, and Database-native tools (e.g., pg\_stat\_statements, EXPLAIN).
* Analyze and optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and resource utilization.
* Investigate and resolve complex production issues, including locking, blocking, replication lag, and connection saturation.
* Implement and manage backup and recovery strategies including point-in-time recovery (PITR), automated snapshots, and cross-region resilience.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve schema design, query patterns, and database access efficiency.
* Drive observability best practices, including alerting, logging, and performance metrics across database environments.
* Optimize cloud database cost and performance, including instance sizing, storage utilization, and workload tuning.
* Support and contribute to database migrations and modernization efforts.
* Automate database provisioning and operations using Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting.
* Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement processes.
* Support MySQL version upgrades, patching, and database migrations with minimal downtime.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of database administration experience, with 3+ years focused on PostgreSQL in high-volume OLTP production environments.
* 2+ years administering MySQL in production, preferably on AWS RDS.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS RDS MySQL.
* Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, including query planner, indexing, vacuuming, WAL, and replication.
* Strong understanding of MySQL architecture, including InnoDB storage engine, replication, indexing, and query optimization.
* Proven expertise in database performance tuning and troubleshooting in high-availability, high-throughput environments.
* Experience supporting systems with significant transaction volume (e.g., 100–200+ TPS) and scaling for continued growth.
* Experience troubleshooting contention scenarios, including locking, blocking, connection saturation, and long-running transactions.
* Experience with AWS services including RDS, Aurora, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as DataDog and CloudWatch.
* Experience designing and supporting High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.
* Strong understanding of relational database design and data modeling.
* Experience with automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) and scripting (Python, Bash, etc.).
* Experience operating in a production SaaS or high-transaction environment.

**Team Member Competencies**

* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for production systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering and operations teams.
* Communicates clearly and effectively in both technical and non-technical contexts.
* Continuously seeks to improve processes, performance, and reliability.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.

You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Cassandra DBA
description:
Cassandra DBA / Engineer – Key Requirements

Database Architecture

* Design and manage highly available, scalable Cassandra clusters.
* Strong understanding of Cassandra architecture, replication, consistency levels, partitioning, data modeling, and multi-DC deployments.
* Capacity planning and cluster topology design.

Cassandra Performance Tuning

* Analyze and optimize read/write performance and latency.
* Tune compaction, caching, consistency levels, tombstones, SSTables, and Cassandra configuration.
* Identify hot partitions, slow queries, and resource bottlenecks.

Node Expansion & Cluster Management

* Add, replace, remove, and decommission Cassandra nodes safely.
* Perform cluster expansion and capacity upgrades with minimal production impact.
* Manage token distribution, bootstrap/streaming, repair, cleanup, and cluster rebalancing.

Backup & Recovery

* Implement and maintain Cassandra backup and restore strategies.
* Perform snapshots, incremental backups, and point-in-time recovery where supported by the backup solution.
* Conduct recovery testing and support disaster-recovery procedures.

JVM & System Tuning

* Tune Cassandra JVM heap, garbage collection, and memory settings.
* Troubleshoot GC pauses, heap pressure, CPU, disk I/O, and memory issues.
* Tune Linux/OS and storage configurations for Cassandra workloads.

Monitoring & Troubleshooting

* Monitor cluster health, availability, latency, throughput, disk usage, compactions, dropped messages, GC, and repairs.
* Troubleshoot production issues including node failures, high latency, timeouts, replica inconsistencies, and capacity problems.
* Strong experience with nodetool, Cassandra logs, metrics, tracing, and monitoring/alerting platforms.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.
  
  
You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.
  
  
Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.
  
  
Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.
  
  
Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.
  
  
Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.
  
  
Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.
  
  
Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.
  
  
Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Data Architect – Microsoft Fabric (US Healthcare)
description:
Designation: Data Architect – Microsoft Fabric (US Healthcare)

Experience: 8 to 10 Years

Location: Bangalore

Budget: 38 LPA

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Data Architect/Engineer to help lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud data platforms for US healthcare clients. You will own the architecture from ingestion through the Gold layer, feeding Power BI semantic models and making the data ready for Power BI Dashboards, Data Agents and AI-driven workflows.

You will work closely with our existing solution leaders and architects to oversee and guide our data engineers, BI developers, analysts and business stakeholders, and will communicate technical trade-offs clearly. This is a team lead role that requires demonstrable experience of leading/managing technical teams of varying levels of experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture and Data Modelling**

• Design data models including star/constellation/ snowflake schemas, and choose the right approach for each subject area based on performance, maintainability and reporting needs.

• Design scalable, medallion-layered (Bronze / Silver / Gold) platforms on Microsoft Fabric using

OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse.

• Translate business requirements into robust, well-documented data models, conformed dimensions and fact grains.

**Data Engineering and Transformation**

• Review and guide ingestion and transformation built with Fabric Pipelines / Azure Data Factory, T-SQL and PySpark notebooks.

• Implement transformation logic to meet business objectives and regulatory requirements, with

schema mapping, reconciliation and data validation to preserve data integrity and security.

• Write and review production-grade SQL for incremental loads, slowly changing dimensions (Type 1 / Type 2), data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliation, and set SQL coding standards and code-review practices for the team.

• Design Power BI semantic models (DAX, RLS, certified datasets) that serve dashboards and Fabric Data Agents, using Direct Lake / Import / Direct Query over Gold-layer Delta tables where appropriate.

**Performance, Compliance and Documentation**

• Analyze performance and optimize across SQL, Spark and Fabric capacity (indexing, partitioning, Delta table design, capacity cost).

• Enforce HIPAA / HITECH controls: PHI minimization, row-level security, auditing and de-identification patterns, aligned with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 practices.

• Maintain documentation of architecture, lineage, data models and data dictionaries.

Required Skills and Qualifications

**• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master's**

**preferred).**

**• 8+ years in data architecture / database design, with 2+ years on a modern cloud data platform (Microsoft Fabric, Synapse or Databricks).**

• Expert-level SQL / T-SQL (complex query design, query optimization, stored procedures) plus advanced knowledge of Python / PySpark.

• Deep command of advanced SQL constructs: window functions, CTEs (including recursive), PIVOT / UNPIVOT, MERGE, set-based logic and dynamic SQL, applied to large, complex healthcare datasets such as claims, encounters and eligibility.

• Proven SQL performance tuning: reading and optimizing execution plans, indexing strategy (clustered, non-clustered, columnstore), statistics, partitioning, and diagnosing blocking, deadlocks and long running queries.

• Hands-on SQL across the Microsoft stack, including Fabric Warehouse, the Lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint and Spark SQL, with a clear understanding of T-SQL surface-area differences between platforms.

• Strong dimensional modelling expertise: Kimball methodology, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and ELT design on Azure.

• Experience with Azure SQL Database, SQL Server and Azure Data Factory, and with data migration

methodologies.

• Strong Power BI semantic modelling skills (DAX, RLS, Direct Lake, performance tuning).

• Experience with Git.

• US healthcare data experience under HIPAA, on either the hospital side or the payer side.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to

explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong leadership and team-player attitude.

**Good to Have**

• Hands-on exposure to Data Agents (Fabric Data Agents, Copilot or similar NL-to-SQL tools) and AI integration (Azure OpenAI, Claude, MCP or agent-based workflows).

• Data governance tooling such as Microsoft Purview.

• Power Automate / Power Apps and React front-end exposure.

• HL7 / FHIR experience.

• Master's degree in a relevant field.

**Additional Skills**

• Passion for the business of hospital transformation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

• Good team player

title: CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems - CTI MD Tech (LRL)
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
LRL takes potential marketable products from Research through product registration and approval, enabling MDU's business needs of the future through information and technology solutions. Within this portfolio, Clinical Supply & Delivery (CS&D) owns the systems and platforms that move investigational drug product — from packaging and labeling through distribution and fulfillment — to clinical trial sites, reliably, compliantly, and on time for trial execution. The CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems is a senior individual contributor who owns hands-on technical delivery for these platforms — designing, building, and directly implementing integration patterns, data pipelines, and platform components that translate portfolio direction and roadmap decisions into production systems.
  
  
**Path/Level:**
R4 (CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems)
  
  
This role is structured as roughly 75% hands-on technical execution — architecting and directly implementing platform components, data pipelines, and integrations — and 25% technical leadership, mentorship, and design guidance for R2/R3 engineers. This is a senior individual-contributor position: candidates should bring sustained, current hands-on engineering depth alongside strong architectural judgment, and should expect to remain an active technical contributor throughout the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Hands-On Engineering & Implementation (75%)**

* Platform Build & Implementation — design, build, and directly implement production components for CS&D's clinical supply chain systems — integration layers, data pipelines, APIs/microservices, and cloud infrastructure — including critical or complex components, in close collaboration with R2/R3 engineers.
* Data Platform Engineering — build and maintain cloud-native data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and data lake/lakehouse solutions across AWS and Databricks/Delta Lake; make and implement database architecture decisions — relational vs. NoSQL vs. NewSQL selection, schema design, partitioning/sharding, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Integration & API Engineering — build API and microservices integration patterns for data access and cross-system integration; implement monitoring, alerting, and observability for data pipelines; diagnose and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
* AI/Agentic System Build — design and build agentic workflows, LLM integration and orchestration, RAG and vector-store implementations, and AI governance/guardrails; develop and validate proofs-of-concept ahead of production adoption.
* Governance, Risk & GxP/GCP Compliance Implementation — implement audit-readiness, security, and change-control practices in code and infrastructure; produce architecture documentation supporting audit, inspection, and CSV readiness.
* Business & Product Partnership — partner with architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into technical solutions; validate technical feasibility through hands-on spikes and prototypes.

**Technical Leadership & Architecture Guidance (25%)**

* Architecture Direction — provide design direction and integration patterns for R2/R3 engineering teams, informed by direct, current experience building comparable systems.
* Code & Design Reviews / Mentorship — conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor engineers through pairing, technical guidance, and shared problem-solving; champion engineering excellence and consistent design standards.
* Decision-Making (Implementation-Scoped) — hold design and integration decision authority for the systems owned; approve implementation-level architecture and integration patterns used by R2/R3 teams; escalate — rather than unilaterally resolve — platform-architecture, investment-level, or cross-portfolio risks to CS&D architecture leadership.
* India-Based Technical Leadership — represent CS&D engineering in relevant technical forums; build shared ownership and accountability between the India team and global stakeholders; strengthen India's role as a technical design and engineering center for the platforms owned.
* Talent Development — contribute to hiring and technical talent planning for the engineering teams, including evaluation of candidates' technical depth.

**Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas**
Cloud-Native Data Platform Architecture (AWS: S3, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, DMS, Lambda, EMR, Athena, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudFormation, CDK, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch)
  
  

* Data Lake / Data Warehouse / Lakehouse Design
* Databricks / Delta Lake
* Database Architecture & Design (relational and NoSQL, indexing, partitioning/sharding strategy)
* Agentic/AI System Design & Build (LLM orchestration frameworks, RAG, vector databases, LLMOps and AI observability)
* Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4 model)
* CI/CD & DevOps (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
* Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK)
* API & Microservices Design
* SQL & Dimensional Data Modelling (Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
* Monitoring, Alerting & Observability
* Streaming Platforms (Kafka, Confluent, AWS MSK)
* Security & Compliance Architecture (GxP, GCP, CSV)
* Cost Optimization (FinOps) & Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity Design
* Front-End & Back-End Development

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 12+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data platform roles, with a sustained, current track record of designing and implementing production systems.
* Strong AWS expertise with hands-on experience across: Data Storage & Warehousing (S3, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB); Data Processing & Integration (Glue, DMS, Lambda, EMR, Athena); API & Orchestration (API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge); Infrastructure (CloudFormation, CDK, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch).
* Strong SQL and data modelling expertise (dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas) across Redshift, Oracle, and SQL Server platforms.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines for data platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK).
* Current, hands-on coding proficiency across front-end, back-end, and AWS cloud development, with the ability to build, debug, and deliver production systems directly.
* Ability to speak in specific, concrete detail about systems designed, technical trade-offs made, and outcomes delivered.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions through hands-on pairing and code review, without requiring a formal people-manager structure.

**Additional Qualifications / Competencies**

* Experience in regulated industries (healthcare/pharma, finance, government) with compliance requirements.
* Experience with clinical data, life sciences, or statistical computing domains.
* Hands-on experience designing and building AI/agentic systems personally — including LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, or similar), vector database and RAG architecture, and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines using AWS services such as SageMaker.
* Familiarity with data governance and metadata management frameworks.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, translating architecture-level decisions into working systems under evolving requirements.
* A portfolio of shipped technical work, relevant open-source contributions, or verifiable examples of production systems delivered end-to-end is a plus.

title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB builds and runs Database Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**
Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
  
  
Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.
  
  
**Related Experience Required**

* Overall, 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as Database Engineer and/or Architect
* Deep understanding of Relational Database technologies (MSSQL, PostgreSQL)
* Understanding of modern database & storage technologies (NoSQL, Caching Services, Time-Series Database, Vector Database, Spatial Database)
* Experience as a DBA
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* undefined
* Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Database Products (Oracle)
* undefined
* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.
* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**#AGTech**
**Skills**
API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Administration, Database Architecture, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, NoSQL, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Times Series, Vector Databases, Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Technical Financial Systems Lead
description:
**Make Your Mark**
BlackLine is looking for an experienced Technical Financial Systems Lead to join our Financial Systems team. In this role, you will be responsible for the development, enhancement, and support of the SAP Commissions platform, working closely with our Sales Compensation team to bring their plans, quotas, and crediting rules to life in the system. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in SAP Commissions, an understanding of incentive compensation frameworks, and the database and SQL skills this platform requires behind the scenes. Because commissions inputs originate in our sales tools and flow through the Quote-to-Revenue (Q2R) stack, this is a highly cross-functional role that partners with Sales Operations, Finance, Accounting, and the Q2R team to deliver solutions that meet business needs while driving operational efficiency.
  
  
The Financial Systems team is AI forward, and AI development tooling is part of how we build, test, and document. We are also extending commissions into more advanced analytics through our financial systems toolkit, Snowflake and Sigma, and this role will be part of that work. The ideal candidate will have experience improving system stability, defining migration procedures, and providing recommendations to the business based on best practices.
  
  
**You'll Get To**

* Develop, configure, and maintain the SAP Commissions platform to support compensation and incentive programs. Implement compensation logic, quota and credit assignments, workflows, and reports as defined by the Sales Compensation team.
* Manage integrations of SAP Commissions with Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Snowflake, and other business applications. Define integration processes, document requirements, and ensure accurate data flow across platforms.
* Perform the database work the platform depends on, including staging and validating inbound data, writing and tuning SQL, reconciling inputs, and tracing calculation or payout discrepancies back to source.
* Collaborate closely with the Q2R team on data definitions, upstream system changes, and testing, so bookings and revenue data tie cleanly to commissions inputs and downstream accrual reporting.
* Contribute to our advanced analytics roadmap by extending commissions reporting into Snowflake and Sigma, so plan performance, attainment, and accrual data sit alongside the rest of the finance data estate.
* Work with business stakeholders to review existing compensation processes and create a roadmap to leverage SAP Commissions' capabilities to increase efficiency and reduce manual interventions. Identify opportunities for process improvements and system optimizations.
* Architect and implement complex customizations, including commission calculation models, reporting, and performance dashboards within SAP Commissions. Ensure scalability and system stability with a focus on long-term performance.
* Lead SAP Commissions development projects through the full SDLC, using AI development tooling for code, tests, migration scripts, and documentation. Manage requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
* Coordinate and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with end users and business teams during the development and customization of new SAP Commissions functionality.
* Provide day-to-day support for SAP Commissions, identifying and resolving issues as they arise. Log and manage tickets, troubleshoot system errors, and ensure timely resolutions during payout cycles.
* Manage change control processes for responsible systems, ensuring compliance with SOX and ITGCs. Document changes, approvals, and appropriate signoff in JIRA.

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of experience with SAP Commissions, including system customization, development, and integrations.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Prior experience working with incentive compensation, commission rules, quotas, and payout structures.
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational or cloud data warehouse environments. Snowflake and Sigma experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with Quote-to-Revenue data across CRM, billing, and ERP systems, and how it feeds compensation.
* Experience using AI development tools as part of everyday coding, testing, and documentation work.
* Advanced understanding of SDLC processes, system deployment, and best practices for quality assurance.
* Ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, with a proven ability to document technical specifications, system configurations, and customizations clearly for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

**Thrive At BlackLine Because You Are Joining**

* A technology-based company with a sense of adventure and a vision for the future. Every door at BlackLine is open. Just bring your brains, your problem-solving skills, and be part of a winning team at the world's most trusted name in Finance Automation!
* A culture that is kind, open, and accepting. It's a place where people can embrace what makes them unique, and the mix of cultural backgrounds and varying interests cultivates diverse thought and perspectives.
* A culture where BlackLiner's continued growth and learning is empowered. BlackLine offers a wide variety of professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups to celebrate and support our diversity.

BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.

title: Yardi Technical Associate
description:
**Function**
Digital Platforms / Technology
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience**
6+ years of hands-on Yardi Voyager development and application support
  
  
**Role Focus**
Technical leadership, team management, Stakeholder delivery and platform improvement
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Yardi Technical Lead Analyst to lead development and application support for a long-term programme. This role combines hands-on Yardi Voyager expertise with technical leadership, team coordination, Stakeholder engagement and continuous platform improvement.
  
  
The successful candidate will set technical direction, manage delivery priorities and serve as a key Stakeholder-facing contact. The role requires strong active listening, clear communication and the ability to translate business requirements into stable, scalable and supportable solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the design, development and maintenance of reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Yardi Standard Reports (YSR).
* Lead Yardi Voyager customization’s, screen development, configuration, workflows, interfaces and integrations using Yardi APIs and web services.
* Develop and review SQL scripts for data migration, validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and controlled data correction.
* Translate approved business requirements into practical technical solutions and formal Technical Specification Documents.
* Oversee incidents, service requests, defects and development tickets from triage through resolution.
* Lead root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Coordinate development, testing, deployment, defect resolution and post-release support.
* Ensure compliance with coding, documentation, testing, change-control and release standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, performance, automation and support processes.

Team and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Allocate and monitor work based on business priorities, team capabilities and delivery commitments.
* Provide technical guidance, solution reviews, mentoring and hands-on support to development and support teams.
* Oversee ticket queues, delivery progress, quality, risks and dependencies, taking timely corrective action.
* Coordinate with CSD, business analysis, testing and platform teams to ensure effective triage and end-to-end delivery.
* Serve as the key technical contact for Yardi development and application support, leading requirement walkthroughs, solution reviews and status meetings.
* Actively listen to Stakeholder needs, clarify requirements and acceptance criteria, and communicate technical options, risks and resolution plans in clear business language.
* Manage Stakeholder expectations through timely updates, transparent communication and consistent delivery.
* Support Stakeholder acceptance, production deployment and post-release activities, escalating delivery, capacity or technical risks through appropriate governance channels.

Delivery Process
  
  

* Review the Business Requirements Document (BRD), scope and internal effort estimate.
* Align stakeholders on assumptions, dependencies, technical approach and delivery effort.
* Prepare or review the Technical Specification Document and obtain approval before development.
* Oversee development, code review, unit testing and deployment to the test environment.
* Coordinate validation, defect resolution and business acceptance.
* Oversee production deployment through approved change-control and release processes.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Six or more years of hands-on Yardi Voyager development and application support experience.
* Strong Microsoft SQL Server expertise, including complex scripting and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience developing and reviewing SSRS and YSR reports.
* Experience with Yardi Voyager customization’s, screens, workflows, APIs and web services.
* Experience preparing and reviewing formal Technical Specification Documents.
* Hands-on experience managing support tickets, including triage, prioritization, investigation, resolution and stakeholder communication.
* Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating technical development and support team.
* Experience collaborating with a Customer Service Delivery team in an application support environment.
* Proven Stakeholder-facing experience across requirements, solution walkthroughs, issue management and delivery reporting.
* Strong written and spoken English, active listening skills and confidence communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, make sound delivery decisions and escalate risks appropriately.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Relevant Yardi certification.
* Experience with Yardi Commercial, Residential and/or Investment Management modules.
* Experience supporting enterprise Stakeholders within formal change-controlled release environments.
* Experience with data migration, reconciliation and high-volume data validation.
* Understanding of real estate, property management, investment management or finance-related processes.

Core Skills and Behaviors
  
  

* Technical leadership, ownership and sound decision-making.
* Team planning, coaching, delegation and delivery management.
* Stakeholder focus, active listening and expectation management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities.
* Clear communication, collaboration and stakeholder management.
* Quality focus, disciplined governance and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Success in the Role
  
  

* High-quality Yardi solutions and support are delivered within agreed priorities and commitments.
* Production issues and support tickets are investigated promptly, communicated clearly and resolved sustainably.
* Stakeholders receive responsive engagement, transparent updates and technically sound solutions.
* Technical specifications, reports, customizations and integrations remain accurate, supportable and appropriately documented.
* Deployments follow agreed governance and change-control requirements.
* Team capability, platform reliability and support effectiveness improve measurably over time.

description:
**Overview**
Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. You can help us to achieve our mission.

Responsibilities
  
  
Demonstrate the ability to adapt to modern technologies and learn quickly.

Demonstrate a passion for mentoring, supporting peers & sharing knowledge.
  
  
Consume and contribute best practices, lessons learned, and intellectual property (IP) to the global Microsoft community with a focus on continuous improvement.
  
  
Foster senior level client relationships and engage with senior level Microsoft and client stakeholders to drive solution success.
  
  
Display strong time, project, and priority management skills.
  
  
Express excellent communication skills, presentation skills, written skills, customer/partner relationships and expectations management.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualifications and Experience:
  
  
Need to have a deep technical background with 10+ years of technology-related experience, including 4+ years delivering data and AI solutions on Microsoft Azure (Experience on AWS or GCP will be an added advantage). Require in depth expertise in the following functional areas.

* Designing and implementing modern data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL.
* Building scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs and Stream Analytics.
* Lakehouse and medallion architecture, including Delta and Parquet formats.
* Data modelling, query optimization and performance tuning.
* Migrating and modernizing legacy data warehouses and on-premises data estates to Azure.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python and PySpark.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (ARM, Bicep or Terraform).

**AI & Machine Learning**

* Designing and delivering generative AI solutions with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and agentic patterns, including retrieval augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering and orchestration frameworks.
* Azure Machine Learning for model development, deployment and MLOps.
* Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence and Cognitive Services.
* Evaluation, grounding and Responsible AI practices.
* Copilot and Copilot Studio extensibility.

**Governance, Security & Analytics**

* Data governance, lineage and cataloguing with Microsoft Purview.
* Securing data and AI workloads using Microsoft Entra ID, private networking, Azure Key Vault, RBAC and encryption.
* Power BI semantic models and enterprise reporting.
* Cost management and platform optimization.

We Would Also Expect You To Be Able To Pass The Following Certifications In The First 12 Months Of Employment With Us, If You Do Not Already Hold Them
  
  

* DP-900: Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals
* AI-900: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals
* DP-700: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior DBA to support complex SQL Server environments in the cloud—both IaaS and PaaS. You’ll lead critical migrations and installations, ensure high availability, administer backups, enforce appropriate security practices, provide performance advice, monitor system health, and respond to outages.
  
  
***Senior Database Administrator***
**Introduction to Maersk:**
A.P. Moller - Maersk is an integrated container logistics company that is responsible for moving 20% of global trade every year. With a dedicated team of over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we go all the way to connect and simplify global trade and help our customers grow and thrive. Maersk’s vision is to be the global integrator of logistics, connecting and simplifying customers’ supply chains.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We're looking for an experienced Senior DBA to support complex SQL Server environments in the cloud—both IaaS and PaaS. You’ll lead critical migrations and installations, ensure high availability, administer backups, enforce appropriate security practices, provide performance advice, monitor system health, and respond to outages.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and manage Microsoft SQL Server platforms (2012 onwards), including availability groups and disaster recovery strategies.
* Plan and execute database migrations to Azure and AWS PaaS, including minimizing downtime and risk during transitions.
* Monitor database and infrastructure performance using Prometheus and Grafana; establish dashboards and alerts to proactively detect issues.
* Automate routine DBA duties such as backups, patching, health checks, and index/statistics maintenance using scripting or orchestration tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues: deadlocks, hung sessions, process blocking, performance bottlenecks, disk I/O or memory/CPU issues.
* Establish robust security practices: user/role management, encryption at rest/in transit (TDE, backup encryption) where required, auditing, and compliance with relevant standards.
* Collaborate with a globally distributed team of developers, network and infrastructure engineers, and tech leaders.
* Develop and maintain runbooks, knowledge base content, playbooks, and documentation to support operations and onboarding.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure 24/7 availability for mission‑critical systems.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience administering SQL Server in enterprise production environments.
* Routine availability for at least 2 hours between 8 AM and 5 PM US Central Time Zone.
* Hands-on experience with database migrations and management in Azure and/or AWS cloud environments.
* Strong T-SQL and PowerShell skills.
* Deep understanding of backup/recovery strategies, high-availability setups, replication, and performance tuning.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to resolve performance and availability issues.
* Effective written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on documentation and cross-team collaboration.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications in AWS, Azure, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Experience with DevOps automation such as CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience mentoring junior DBAs or developing internal training.
* Cloud spending optimization skills.
