title: Data Platforms Operations Expert
description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en) .
  
  
**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
  
  
**Purpose And Scope**
The Data Operations Specialist is responsible for implementing practical and efficient ways to organize and process data, to enable measurement, analytics and reporting that will be used to develop actionable insight for inclusion in reports that communicate the value of Data Strategy activities. In this role, you are to build and cultivate trusted partnerships with groups from various areas of the company (within Data Strategy and outside such as with Omnichannel Strategy & Operations, Information Systems (DX), Finance, Legal, Ethics & Compliance, etc.) as well as with external vendors/suppliers. Your focus is enforcing data standards. Your pivotal responsibility lies in fostering effective collaboration, communication, and strategic alignment with the mentioned groups to propel the Data Strategy practice forward in the quality and efficiency of their analytics and reporting. This role operates within the Customer Engagement Excellence (CEE) group, which supports capabilities across VALUE Delivery, including Commercial (Sales/Marketing), Market Access and Medical Affairs, whilst prioritizing ethical decision making. During all such activities, there is a need to ensure that the integrity and independence of Medical Affairs capabilities is not compromised. You are expected to proactively communicate and consult with your Chapter and Value Team Leads as necessary to ensure that the integrity and independence of Medical Affairs is maintained at all times.
  
  
This is a global role that is also expected to build trusted partnerships with global, regional, and affiliate groups from various areas of the company (with co-colleagues within Value Delivery and outside such as Information Systems (DX), Brand teams, Procurement, HR, etc.) as well as with external vendors/suppliers. Your strategic mindset and commitment to modern data technologies will be key in shaping our data landscape.
  
  
The Chapter Member receives capability and skillset development under the guidance of the Chapter Lead, who provides coaching and mentoring within the Agile model.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**

* Data Sourcing & Acquisition:
* Work closely with Business to understand data needs, assess and prioritize new data use cases, and ensure Analytics Data Layer supports business reporting and measurable outcomes.
* Conduct due diligence to validate data quality, reliability, and alignment with business objectives.
* Serve as an SME for data pipeline (including ADL, Databricks, and legacy data management) and technical SME for dashboards which consume data.
* Identify and implement opportunities for efficiency gains in data workflows, processes, and systems.
* Continuously evaluate tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve data operations efficiency and scalability.
* Data Onboarding:
* Ensure data is properly formatted, validated, and transformed for marketing analytics and reporting, holding external vendors accountable for data accuracy and timeliness.
* Establish data validation frameworks to assess the completeness, timeliness, and accuracy of onboarded datasets, implementing monitoring mechanisms to detect and resolve integration issues proactively.
* Partner with IT teams to ensure smooth integration of new data sources into the organization's data infrastructure.
* Clean, standardize, and transform data to align with marketing and analytical requirements.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data dictionaries and metadata documentation.
* Data Management & Governance:
* Define, implement, and ensure adherence to data standards for structure, consistency, and interoperability across systems and teams.
* Oversee the storage, organization, and accessibility of promotional marketing data ensuring compliance with internal governance standards.
* Develop and enforce data quality standards to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Partner with stakeholders to create standardized data taxonomies and classification frameworks to improve usability.
* Partner with stakeholders to transform ingested data into analytic ready formats.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data issues, implementing corrective measures when necessary, communicating data-related issues and resolutions to stakeholders.
* Provide strategic guidance on data source quality, context and usage based on business needs and analytical use cases.
* Coordinate and facilitate data source changes and communication to necessary business stakeholders.
* Assist the Data Foundation Pod in triaging new projects to determine appropriate ownership and/or engagement from the Value Teams within and outside of the Data Foundation Pod, necessary Capability teams, and potentially other Hub groups.
* Champion the adoption of Agile methodology in both project delivery and continuous integrations and continuous delivery (CI/CD) of efficient and scalable data management, reporting, and analytics solutions.
* Medical Affairs Enablement:
* Contribute to the expansion of Medical Affairs systems and solutions which may include Clinical Trial Management (CTMS), external funding and grants, Vault Medical content management system, and medical incident reporting functions.
* Ensure that data operations supporting Medical Affairs preserve the integrity and independence of the function, applying appropriate governance, access controls, and privacy safeguards when onboarding and managing medical, clinical, and R&D data sources.
* Reporting & Automation:
* Provide regular updates on data availability, integrity, and performance to key stakeholders.
* Maintain a schedule for data delivery and loading.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process automation to enhance operational efficiency.
* Stay informed on emerging industry trends and advancements in marketing data and data management, advising leadership on innovative solutions that complement and drive business growth.
* Agile:
* Utilize agile approaches, collaborate in agile ceremonies and Ways of Working to ensure effective delivery for the business
* Collaborate and foster a culture of collaboration, flexibility, and responsiveness to change, enabling the team to thrive in an agile environment

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer or Information/Data Science, Information Systems, or STEM field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in data management, with a focus on digital marketing datasets
* Experience in sourcing, onboarding, and managing large datasets from external vendors.
* Proficiency with a coding language (e.g. SQL, Python), MS Excel and PowerPoint, ETL/data processing tools.
* Exposure to and/or good understanding of Data Warehousing/Data Lakehouse platforms and technologies (e.g., AWS S3/RedShift, SQL, etc.)
* Good understanding of data stewardship and governance concepts (e.g., data ingestion, reference data management, data transformations, data quality and observability, data archiving, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to understand business requirements as well as underlying infrastructure applications, systems, and processes. Proven experience in process mapping, process improvement, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability in taking initiative to proactively evaluate existing strategies and processes and recommend best-fit solutions when appropriate.
* Deep understanding of marketing data types (campaign data, engagement metrics, media spend) and their applications.
* Familiarity with marketing tech platforms like CM360, SA360, Meta.
* Experience working with Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics.
* Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Power BI).
* Proven ability to align data initiatives with business objectives, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent organizational, project planning and business change management skills with a strong attention to detail and ability to effectively manage cross-functional projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and influencing skills to effectively interact to a diverse audience.
* Extensive computer proficiency in other Microsoft products: Excel, VBA, Macros, Access, Visio, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in Computer or Information/Data Science, Information Systems, or STEM field
* Understanding of Data models for platforms like CM360
* Pharmaceutical industry experience
* Experience working with Databricks
* Strong understanding of data architecture, engineering, operations, and reporting within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry across Commercial, Medical (R&D), and Finance domains.

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. title: Senior IT Analyst Applications
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Roles And Responsibilities****

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand dealer order-planning, product-structure, interface, data, reporting, and operational-planning needs.
* Collect, analyze, document, and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and traceability for application changes.
* Assess enhancement requests and production issues, clarify business value and impact, and support backlog refinement with product and technical teams.
* Level 4 support for product incidents, service requests, data issues, and recurring defects; analyze application behavior, interfaces, logs, batch dependencies, and business impact to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate development requests with developers, database teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity partners, and vendors; validate that fixes address the documented business need.
* Manage enhancements and code fixes from demand intake through implementation, including scope clarification, test planning, business validation, release readiness, and post-production verification.
* Develop functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios; coordinate test execution, document evidence, manage defects, and confirm solution quality.
* Create and maintain application support procedures, interface inventories, data mappings, knowledge articles, and business continuity or recovery instructions.
* Facilitate communication between business and technical teams by translating business needs into clear solution requirements and technical issues into understandable business impacts and options.
* Identify opportunities for product modernization, process simplification, automation, improved controls, stronger monitoring, and reduced manual support effort.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, vendors, and business users throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, solution analysis, application support, product support, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications and coordinating production incident, problem, change, and release activities.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate business-process, application, interface, and data issues.
* Experience developing test scenarios, coordinating user acceptance testing, managing defects, and validating production changes.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, interfaces, batch processing, and system integration or data-flow analysis.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and manage work across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong skills in accountability, organization, collaboration, customer focus, and managing priorities under time constraints.

****Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications****

* Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning, dealer demand or order planning, order management, product configuration, bill of materials, or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of S&OP business processes, data structures, batch cycles, interfaces, controls, and downstream dependencies.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET and Python applications sufficient to support requirement analysis, issue triage, testing, and collaboration with developers.
* Experience with Oracle, Snowflake, Windows Server, FTP or secure file transfer, load-balanced applications, and operational-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

****What You Will Have****
**Business Analysis:**
Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Core Application Systems:**
Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.
  
  
**Analytical Thinking:**
Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.
  
  
**Application Delivery Process:**
Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.
  
  
**System and Technology Integration:**
Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.
  
  
**Software Quality Management:**
Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.
  
  
**Problem Management:**
Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.
  
  
**Information Security Technologies:**
Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management:**
Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.
  
  
****What Success Looks Like****

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

****What You Will Get****

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

****Additional Information****
Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Lead Database Administrator
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**The Role**
A Senior Database Administrator at Razorpay is well-grounded - responsible for managing and maintaining databases. Their primary role is to ensure the integrity, security, and performance of the databases that store and retrieve data critical to the organization's operations. Engineering creates a significant impact across different areas, considering the scale of product outreach. You’re also expected to influence the culture of the company and help shape it in the right way.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our database infrastructure.
* Work closely with application teams to ship solutions that integrate seamlessly with our database systems.
* Analyze solutions and implement best practices for supported data stores (primarily MySQL and PostgreSQL).
* Develop and enforce best practices for database security, backup, and recovery.
* Work on the observability of relevant database metrics and make sure we reach our database objectives.
* Provide database expertise to engineering teams (for example, through reviews of database migrations, queries, and performance optimizations).
* Work with peers (DevOps, Application Engineers) to roll out changes to our production environment and help mitigate database-related production incidents.
* Work on automation of database infrastructure and help engineering succeed by providing self-service tools.
* OnCall support on rotation with the team.
* Support and debug database production issues across services and levels of the stack.
* Document every action so your learning turns into repeatable actions and then into automation.
* Perform regular system monitoring, troubleshooting, and capacity planning to ensure scalability.
* Create and maintain documentation on database configurations, processes, and procedures.

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* Have at least 6+ years of experience running MySQL/PostgreSQL databases in large environments.
* Awareness of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
* Have knowledge of the internals of MySQL/PostgreSQL.
* Knowledge of load balancing solutions such as ProxySQL to distribute database traffic efficiently across multiple servers.
* Knowledge of tools and methods for monitoring database performance.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of caching (Redis / Elasticache)
* Knowledge of scripting languages (Python)
* Knowledge of infrastructure automation (Terraform/Ansible)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

description:
**Project Role :**
Packaged/SaaS App Engineering Lead
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Own the design and evolution of packaged or SaaS solutions, overseeing configuration, integrations, and releases. Set platform standards to ensure stability, performance, and alignment with business and vendor constraints.

IBM DB2 Database Administration

NA

15 years full time education
  
  
IBM DB2 ZoS Database Administrator
  
  
As a Database Administrator, the role involves ensuring the stability, performance, and reliability of enterprise database environments. A typical day includes managing database configurations, monitoring system health, and optimizing performance to support seamless application operations. The role requires overseeing database maintenance activities such as backups, recovery, patching, and version upgrades.
  
  
The individual is responsible for implementing and maintaining database standards, ensuring data integrity, security, and compliance with organizational policies. Collaboration with application teams, infrastructure teams, and stakeholders is essential to align database solutions with business needs and system requirements. The role also demands a proactive approach to identifying performance bottlenecks, resolving issues, and continuously improving the database ecosystem to meet evolving demands.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Monitor, analyze, and ensure the performance, health, and availability of DB2 systems and associated applications.
  
  
Perform performance tuning, including dynamic SQL tuning and access path analysis.
  
  
Manage database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning, ensuring business continuity.
  
  
Handle DB2 and application problem determination and resolution in production environments.
  
  
Design and maintain logical and physical database structures.
  
  
Execute regular database maintenance activities such as REORG and RUNSTATS.
  
  
Work with DB2 utilities and monitoring tools (e.g., DB2 Administration tools, Omegamon).
  
  
Support and manage IBM Db2 Analytics Accelerator for z/OS (IDAA).
  
  
Manage and administer Db2 Data Sharing environments in z/OS Sysplex environments
  
  
Handle RACF security administration for DB2 environments.
  
  
Manage and monitor job scheduling using ITWS (IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler).
  
  
Develop and maintain automation scripts using REXX, CLIST, and JCL.
  
  
Design and develop reports/tools to improve operational efficiency.
  
  
Ensure high availability of systems supporting large-scale online transaction and batch workloads in 24x7 production environments.
  
  
Participate in release management, database upgrades, and environment stability initiatives.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in IBM DB2 ZoS Database Administration.
* Strong knowledge of database configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in managing database integrations within complex software environments.
* Ability to design and implement database release and upgrade strategies.
* Familiarity with backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning for database systems.
* Skilled in monitoring database health and ensuring data integrity and security.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in IBM DB2 ZoS Database Administration.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Cognite operates at the forefront of
**industrial digitalization, building AI**
, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

**About The Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE)**
to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.

You will work across
**PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka**
, supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.

You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.

**What You’ll Own**

**Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration**

* Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
* Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.
* Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.
* Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL.
* Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.

**Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations**

* Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.
* Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.
* Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
* Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore.
* Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.
* Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.

**Kafka Streaming Infrastructure**

* Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.
* Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.
* Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.
* Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).
* Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.
* Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.
* Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale, preferably in cloud-managed environments.
* Strong experience with Elasticsearch, including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.
* Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform — Azure, AWS, or GCP — with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.
* Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language.
* Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK.

**Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus.**

* Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.
* Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments.
* Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.
* Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.
* Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.
* Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.
* Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.
* Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.

**Why This Role?**

This is an opportunity to work on
**large-scale, distributed data infrastructure**
at the heart of a modern Knowledge Graph platform. You will have significant ownership across three critical database technologies and will play a key role in making our data infrastructure more automated, reliable, and scalable.

**Learn More About Us**

* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

***Equal Opportunity***

*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Data Migration Consultants
description:
**Experience -**
6+Years

Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Noida, Gurugram, Kolkata

Engineering Bachelors or Masters

**Job Description :**

We are seeking experienced
**Oracle Fusion Cloud Data Migration Consultants**
to support the migration of master, reference, and transactional data into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement. The consultants will work closely with functional, technical, business, and source-system teams to ensure that data is extracted, transformed, validated, loaded, reconciled, and signed off successfully.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute end-to-end data migration activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement.
* Work with business and functional teams to identify source data, transformation rules, dependencies, and target-system requirements.
* Prepare and maintain data-migration strategies, object lists, mapping documents, conversion specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, and duplicate analysis.
* Develop and validate Oracle data-load files using tools and methods such as FBDI, ADFdi, spreadsheet loaders, REST APIs, SOAP services, and scheduled processes.
* Support the migration of relevant data objects, including:
* Chart of Accounts and other financial reference data
* Suppliers, supplier sites, contacts, addresses, and bank details
* Procurement business units, agents, categories, and approved supplier information
* Purchase agreements, purchase orders, requisitions, and related open transactions
* Customers, customer accounts, sites, contacts, and profiles
* Payables and Receivables open transactions
* General Ledger balances and journals
* Fixed Assets and Cash Management data, where applicable
* Analyse and resolve load errors, rejected records, reference-data issues, and data-quality exceptions.
* Ensure that parent-child relationships and cross-file references remain consistent across migration files.
* Perform pre-load and post-load validations and reconcile migrated data against source-system totals.
* Support mock conversions, conference-room pilots, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, and production deployment.
* Maintain migration logs, issue trackers, control totals, exception reports, and sign-off documentation.
* Coordinate with Oracle functional and technical teams to address configuration and integration dependencies.
* Support production cutover and post-go-live data-migration activities.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement data migration.
* Experience in at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation involving data conversion.
* Practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion FBDI templates, interface tables, import processes, and error-resolution procedures.
* Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials and Procurement data structures and business processes.
* Experience with data extraction, mapping, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation.
* Ability to analyse large data files and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid records.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing data extracts and reconciliation queries.
* Experience working with CSV files, Microsoft Excel, and data-transformation utilities.
* Strong understanding of data dependencies, reference keys, sequencing, and parent-child relationships.
* Ability to prepare technical design documents, mapping documents, load instructions, and reconciliation reports.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with business users, functional consultants, developers, and project management teams.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple migration objects, and meet project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud certification in Financials, Procurement, or related areas.
* Experience migrating data from Oracle E-Business Suite or other legacy ERP applications.
* Knowledge of BI Publisher, OTBI, Oracle Integration Cloud, REST APIs, and SOAP web services.
* Experience with high-volume data migration and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting multiple mock conversions and production cutovers.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit, security, and handling sensitive financial and supplier information.

**Expected Deliverables**

* Approved data-migration strategy and object inventory
* Source-to-target mapping and transformation documents
* Validated data-load files
* Load execution and error-resolution reports
* Source-to-target reconciliation results
* Cutover plans and execution checklists
* Migration completion and business sign-off documentation

title: Data Engineering (Internship)
description:
SwiftB2B is an AI operating system for global supply chains that delivers live, item-level visibility and autonomous orchestration. The platform serves 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers, helping them monitor every item, shipment, and exception in real time. SwiftB2B enables users to act automatically across the entire supply chain, from first mile to final decision, improving efficiency and responsiveness. As a technology-focused organization, SwiftB2B offers opportunities to work with advanced AI, data, and automation solutions that drive modern supply chain innovation.

This is a paid, full-time remote Internship. This role will support our data engineering team in collecting, cleaning, and organizing data from multiple sources. Day-to-day tasks may include assisting with data pipelines, contributing to data models, performing basic data quality checks, and collaborating with engineers and analysts to ensure accurate and reliable data. This role also involves documenting processes, learning best practices in data management, and participating in team meetings to understand how data powers AI-driven supply chain visibility and orchestration.
Interns who do excellent work often get a full-time offer with us before the six months are up.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Data Analytics and Data Analysis to interpret and work with structured and unstructured datasets.
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to identify trends, troubleshoot data issues, and support data-driven decisions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Management to organize, maintain, and ensure the integrity of data across systems.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Modeling to help design and optimize data structures that support AI and reporting needs.
* Foundational knowledge of SQL or another query language, and familiarity with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Scala).
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, curiosity to learn, and interest in AI, data engineering, and supply chain technology.

**What we are looking for**

* Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or anyone who has taught themselves and can show it.
* Python and SQL you have actually used on a dataset bigger than a CSV.
* Curiosity about how goods move around the world. You do not need logistics knowledge; you need to want it.
* You have built something with data, even a small thing, and can show us.

**How to apply**

Send a link to something you built with data: a repo, a notebook, a dashboard, a blog post. Two or three sentences on what was hard about it. That counts for more than just your grades/ resume.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on talent, skill and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

title: Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II - State Street Investment Management
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
State Street Investment Management’s Data, Analytics & AI Services (DAAIS) team is seeking an experienced hands-on architect, engineer for building the multi-cloud open architecture-based data platform that delivers trusted data products to the business functions. This role is an 80% IC role in doing hands-on engineering and developing POCs to support a resilient, scalable, performance optimized, secure multi-cloud data platform, and 20% of the capacity is responsible for managing and mentoring the employees, based out of Bangalore, responsible for the production maintenance & support of the legacy data platform. The successful candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in large-scale data platform architecture, distributed computing, data pipeline engineering, and modern cloud architecture and operational experience.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Investment Management, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II, you will -
  
  

* Validate target data platform architectures and design principles through hands-on engineering, technical spikes, and POCs for a unified, cloud-native Lakehouse.
* Partner with architects to translate reference architectures and data strategies into working prototypes, measurable validation criteria, and production-ready implementation patterns.
* Optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python/Scala, SQL, Spark, and modern orchestration frameworks.
* Engineer high-performance Iceberg-based data models and tables, including partitioning, compaction, schema evolution, metadata management, and multi-engine interoperability.
* Establish data engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, reliability, versioning, and backward-compatible data product contracts.
* Optimize platform, pipeline, and query performance through workload testing, partitioning and clustering, caching, concurrency management, and cost-aware lifecycle practices.
* Lead capabilities from POC to production by defining non-functional requirements, resolving engineering risks, integrating with platform services, and enabling operational support and SLA readiness.
* Engineer AI-ready data products with trusted, well-governed, semantically enriched data, incorporating context engineering, ontologies, embeddings, vector indexing, and RAG patterns.
* Build and productionize data services for Agentic and AI workloads, including MCP-enabled access, interoperable APIs, LLM gateways, multi-model routing, caching, observability, security, and cost optimization.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to the L2/L3 support teams for legacy platform to ensure SLA adherence, escalation discipline, and timely closure of production issues impacting business, clients, or regulators.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services.
* Expert-level hands-on programming in Python and SQL, with Java or Scala as a plus, and proven ability to design, debug, test, and optimize distributed data-processing solutions.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization.
* Proven experience building and operating enterprise Lakehouse and data platforms using Snowflake and Databricks, supporting high-concurrency analytical, near-real-time, and AI-ready workloads.
* Strong cloud engineering experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including cloud-native data services, security, networking, infrastructure automation, portability, and cost management.
* Working expertise with open data architectures and metadata ecosystems, including Apache Iceberg, schema evolution, table optimization, catalog federation, zero-copy sharing, data virtualization, and multi-engine access.
* Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns
* Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation).
* Expertise in AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot or Claude Code Assistant.

title: Data Governance Manager
description:
**Responsibilities:**

·
**Build and lead a high-performing Data Quality team:**
hire, coach, and grow a team of DQ engineers, DQ analysts, and tech leads; own performance management and career development, and build succession depth by growing the next layer of DQ leaders within the GSC.

·
**Own the enterprise data quality strategy and roadmap:**
define the DQ vision, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for EDP, aligned with the Enterprise Data Governance Policy and Data Quality Policy and Standards, and evolve it as the data product portfolio scales.

·
**Architect the “fabric of protection”:**
design a layered, defense-in-depth DQ framework across the Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers of the lakehouse — shift-left validations in pipelines, circuit breakers that stop bad data from propagating, and continuous observability on data products in production.

·
**Drive proactive anomaly detection:**
implement rule-based and statistical monitors for freshness, volume, schema drift, distribution, and business-metric anomalies to catch issues before they reach dashboards, stores, or partners, with tuned thresholds to minimize fatigue.

·
**Build strong reactive capabilities:**
establish a DQ incident management process covering triage, severity classification (P0–P3), on-call, impact assessment through lineage, root-cause analysis, remediation SLAs, and blameless post-mortems, with measurable reductions in MTTD and MTTR.

·
**Live and speak the language of data:**
go deep into datasets — profiling, reconciliation, and understanding the business semantics of sales, transactions, loyalty, inventory, and supply chain data — to identify recurring trends, systemic weak points, and root causes across domains, and convert them into preventive controls.

·
**Operationalize data governance:**
translate data governance and data quality policies and standards into enforceable, automated controls — data ownership and stewardship models, metadata and lineage completeness, business glossary alignment, data classification (PII / PCI), and audit-ready evidence of quality.

·
**Institutionalize quality expectations for data products:**
partner with data product owners and stewards to define critical data elements (CDEs), data contracts, quality SLAs/SLOs, and governed / certified asset criteria so that every certified data product has explicit, measurable quality expectations and a named owner.

·
**Own the DQ platform and tooling:**
evolve our enterprise data observability platform, Databricks / Unity Catalogue native quality checks, metadata-driven rules frameworks, reusable DQ libraries, and the self-service DQ portal, driving automation, reuse, and adoption across engineering teams.

·
**Embed data quality as code:**
ensure DQ rules are versioned in Git, automated checks run in CI/CD, pipelines have test automation, and quality gates block the promotion of non-conforming data or code.

·
**Measure and make quality visible:**
define and publish DQ KPIs and scorecards — dimension scores (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, uniqueness), domain health scores, incident trends, and SLA adherence — and surface quality at the point of use through the data catalogue and BI dashboards.

·
**Be the voice of data trust:**
run DQ and governance forums with data owners and stewards, partner with stakeholders across the organization, and brief senior leadership on DQ posture, risks, and business impact.

·
**Champion a “quality is everyone's job” culture:**
role-model the 7-Eleven Leadership Principles, drive DQ accountability across producing and consuming teams, and bring outside-in industry best practices.

**Educational & Required Qualifications:**

· 10–14 years of experience in data quality, data governance with at least 5–8 years leading data quality teams is a must

· Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing data quality teams and programs at enterprise scale — able to show how the DQ program measurably improved data trust and business outcomes.

· Deep, hands-on expertise in data quality dimensions, data profiling, rule design, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis across large, complex, multi-source datasets.

· Strong grounding in data governance — data ownership and stewardship, metadata and lineage, data catalogues (e.g., Alation, Collibra), business glossaries, data contracts, CDEs, and data classification; awareness of privacy and compliance requirements (e.g., PCI, PII).

· Strong hands-on SQL and Python / PySpark skills — able to dig into the data personally to diagnose issues and validate fixes.

· Hands-on experience with DQ / observability tools — e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ / DQX, Informatica DQ.

· Solid understanding of the modern data stack on cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP) — Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, and medallion / lakehouse architectures.

· Working knowledge of statistical anomaly detection — time-series baselining, seasonality, and outliers.

· Experience establishing data incident management practices — severity models, SLAs, on-call, RCA, and ticketing integration (JIRA / ServiceNow).

· Strong SDLC rigor across CI/CD, version control (Git / GitLab), test automation, and DataOps practices.

· AI-savvy — pragmatic about using AI-assisted tools to accelerate data quality and governance work.

· Excellent communication skills — able to translate data issues into business impact, brief senior stakeholders, and influence across a matrixed global organization.

· Prior experience in retail, e-commerce, CPG, or convenience-retail organizations strongly preferred — with exposure to sales, transaction, loyalty, merchandising, supply chain, or store operations data.

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. Certifications such as DAMA CDMP or Databricks are a plus.

title: SDE2 - Customer Experience (L2)
description:
**About Zinier**
80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  
At Zinier, our Support Engineers leverage a strong foundation in JavaScript development, API integrations, and MySQL or any SQL based DBMS. Expertise in React would be an added bonus. We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to bring advanced technical depth and independent ownership to our Customer Experience function.
  
  
In this role, you will handle complex technical escalations, mentor junior engineers, and act as a strategic liaison between Support, Product, and Engineering. This opportunity is ideal for senior developers who excel in high-impact environments, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and want to shape our customer experience standards—with clear career progression pathways into senior technical or customer-centric roles, such as Senior Software Development Engineer, Solution Developer, Solution Architect and Delivery. For those who are interested in Customer Success, that could be a career path as well. Identify gaps in knowledge-base articles and contribute new documentation to reduce repeat queries. Ideate and implement AI solutions that would help customer experience or improve the product itself.
  
  
This role will be mapped to customers’ locations across the world and hence would primarily be working in US and EMEA working hours which would be compensated accordingly. In future this role might be required to work over weekends as well.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and resolve advanced L2 incidents end-to-end, including root-cause analysis, customer communication, and post-incident documentation.
* Investigate escalated issues involving JavaScript workflow logic, JSON configuration errors, API anomalies, and database irregularities.
* Analyse Grafana dashboards and observability stacks (Loki, Tempo) to detect and diagnose system anomalies proactively.
* Review and optimize SQL queries to identify performance bottlenecks and data integrity issues during live incidents.
* Mentor and guide Software Development Engineer(L1) on debugging approaches, RCA writing, and escalation best practices.
* Lead knowledge-base initiatives — authoring runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and technical SOPs.
* Partner with engineering and solutions teams in postmortems, providing structured feedback to improve product robustness.
* Contribute to AI solutioning, tooling and internal automation that reduces manual effort across the support function.
* Participate in on-call rotations and lead critical-incident response when senior escalation is needed outside business hours.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in JavaScript development, Solutions development, Application Support, Customer Engineering or a related role.
* Strong hands-on skills in JavaScript (workflow debugging, process rule analysis) and JSON handling.
* Proficiency in SQL — able to write, debug, and optimise queries and diagnose data anomalies.
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus.
* Solid understanding of REST API interactions, HTTP semantics, and integration patterns.
* Experience with AWS or equivalent cloud platform at a working level.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior engineers and drive knowledge-sharing within a team.
* Excellent communication skills — able to distill complex technical findings into clear customer and internal communications.

**Desirable Skills**

* Exposure to backend development in Java/Spring Boot or frontend in React.
* Understanding of field service management or workflow-orchestration domains.
* ITIL V3/V4 foundation or equivalent service-management certification.
* Experience building or contributing to AI solutions, internal tooling or automation scripts.

WHY JOIN US
  
  

* Unique opportunity to form a front-facing layer that not only is the front-line to customer deployments, but also has the ability to work closely with Solution Architects and others to influence Product blueprints.
* Work across the full tech stack — from debugging backend services(Java, spring boot) to exploring front-end interfaces built with React and extending into mobile UI development.
* Build internal tools, fix production issues, and contribute to engineering stability, all while learning from experienced platform, product and solution engineers.
* Be part of a high-impact team that bridges engineering and customer experience, where your work helps improve both product quality and customer trust.
* Join a company that values learning, ownership, and long-term growth.
* Top performers progress to:

+ Principal Software Development Engineer, Support Engineering
+ Solution Developer, Solution Delivery
+ Solution Architect, Solution Architecture
+ Customer Success Manager, Customer Success

title: Lead Analyst - Master Data Management (MDM / Master Data Management))
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition:**
Shaping the Future of Enterprise Master Data Management within Enterprise Data & Analytics. Lead and strengthen MDM data consumption, quality, validation, and downstream reporting processes. Drive data integrity across Customer 360 / Reference 360 ecosystems while enabling high-quality, governed, and analytics-ready data for enterprise and regulatory consumption.
  
  
Contribute to the evolution of data culture by building and enhancing data infrastructure, reporting frameworks, optimizing data pipelines, Data remediation for Regulatory Reporting needs and mentoring teams on data storytelling and visualization best practices with advanced data technologies and experience.
  
  
**Job Details**

* Position Title: Lead Data Analyst – Enterprise Data & Analytics
* Career Level: P3
* Job Category: Manager
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bangalore
* Shift Timing - 2 pm - 11 pm

**About The Team**
This role operates within the
**MDM Data Management – Customer 360 / Reference 360 Programme**
, supporting enterprise-wide data consumption and downstream reporting. The team ensures that MDM golden records are accurately propagated across APIs, batch pipelines, Snowflake, and reporting layers.
  
  
The Lead Analyst plays a critical role in bridging
**data producers and consumers**
, ensuring that MDM data is reliable, well-documented, and aligned with business and regulatory expectations. Working collaboratively with cross-functional pod members, the Business Analyst will drive efficient workflows, optimize data systems, and support iterative delivery in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  
  
**Impact**
The P3 Junior MDM Analyst supports the analysis, validation, and documentation activities required to ensure that data flowing from MDM 360 (Customer 360 / Reference 360) into downstream systems is accurate, consistent, and fit for purposes.
  
  
This is an analyst — not a developer — role. Rather than building pipelines or writing production code, the Junior MDM Analyst interprets data flows, documents findings, validates data quality, supports requirements gathering, and assists with UAT and reconciliation reviews across consumption and reporting workstreams.
  
  
This role is an excellent entry point into MDM programme delivery, offering exposure to:
  
  
***MDM 360 → APIs / Batch → Snowflake → Financial Reporting → UI Consumption***
**Key Deliverables (Duties & Responsibilities)**

* MDM Data Understanding & Documentation
* Develop a working understanding of MDM golden record structures and how data flows from MDM 360 to downstream systems
* Document data flows, field mappings, and transformation logic under the guidance of the P4 Analyst or BA Lead
* Maintain and update data mapping registers, attribute lists, and business rule logs as requirements evolve
* Assist in maintaining the MDM data dictionary — recording field definitions, data types, and ownership
* Note and escalate data anomalies or gaps in documentation identified during analysis activities
* Data Validation & Quality Checking

Supporting validation across the consumption data flow — from MDM through to reporting:
  
  

* Run and review data validation checks across:

+ MDM golden records vs. API payload outputs
+ Batch pipeline outputs vs. expected source data
+ Snowflake consumption layer vs. MDM source records
+ UI-displayed data vs. MDM and Snowflake outputs

* Use SQL (with guidance) to query datasets, identify discrepancies, and validate attribute-level accuracy
* Apply data quality checks across key dimensions — completeness, accuracy, consistency — and document outcomes
* Log and track data quality issues in agreed tooling (e.g. JIRA, SharePoint, Excel trackers)
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact data discrepancies to the P4 Analyst or BA Lead promptly

* Downstream Reporting & Financial Data Support
* Support validation of MDM data used in financial and regulatory reporting layers
* Assist in reconciliation activities between:

+ MDM golden records and Snowflake reporting datasets
+ Reporting output and expected business values for key financial attributes and hierarchies

* Document reconciliation results clearly — noting matched records, mismatches, and volumes
* Assist in investigating data breaks and reporting discrepancies by gathering relevant data and preparing findings for P4 review
* Track and follow up on outstanding reconciliation items through to resolution
* Requirements Support & Analysis Documentation

Supporting the P4 BA in translating business needs into clear, documented requirements:
  
  

* Attend requirements workshops, take structured notes, and circulate agreed actions and decisions
* Assist in drafting user stories, acceptance criteria, and data mapping specifications under senior guidance
* Review and cross-check requirements documents for completeness, consistency, and alignment with MDM data standards
* Maintain up-to-date requirements logs and traceability matrices for the consumption workstream
* Raise questions and clarification points with the P4 Analyst when requirements are unclear or ambiguous
* API & Batch Pipeline Validation Support

**From An Analysis — Not Development — Standpoint**

* Review API payload structures (JSON) and validate that field mappings match agreed data specifications
* Use API testing tools (Postman, Swagger) under guidance to inspect responses and document findings
* Monitor batch job outcomes and validate data completeness and successful execution against expected results
* Log pipeline validation findings and assist in drafting defect descriptions for technical teams
* Track open pipeline issues through to resolution, providing status updates to the P4 lead
* UAT Support & Defect Tracking
* Support UAT activities across API, batch, Snowflake, and reporting validation scenarios
* Execute test cases defined by the P4 Analyst or BA Lead — validate data movement accuracy and business rule adherence
* Log defects clearly and completely in agreed defect tracking tools — including steps to reproduce, observed vs. expected results, and data evidence
* Track defects through to resolution and retest fixes as required
* Assist in preparing UAT summary notes and test evidence for sign-off activities

**Skills And Experience**
Analytical Skills
  
  

* Strong attention to detail — able to spot discrepancies in data across multiple systems
* Structured thinking and ability to organise findings clearly in written form
* Comfortable working with large datasets and identifying patterns, gaps, or anomalies
* Ability to ask the right questions and escalate issues appropriately

Data & Technical Acumen
  
  

* Intermediate SQL — able to write and run queries for data validation, comparison, and reconciliation (joins, filters, aggregations)
* Familiarity to some expertise in API concepts (REST/JSON) — able to read and interpret payloads with guidance
* Basic exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms (querying and exploring data)
* Understanding of data quality concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness
* Comfortable using tools such as Excel, JIRA, Confluence, Postman, or Swagger for analysis and tracking tasks

MDM & Data Knowledge
  
  

* Basic understanding of Master Data Management concepts — what MDM is, why golden records matter, and how data flows between systems
* Awareness of how downstream systems (Snowflake, reporting tools, UI applications) consume MDM data
* Exposure to Informatica Customer 360 / Reference 360 is a plus, but not required

Soft Skills
  
  

* Proactive learner — eager to build MDM and data analysis knowledge on the job
* Clear written communication — able to document findings, defects, and notes in a structured, readable format
* Reliable and organized — able to manage assigned tasks, track progress, and meet deadlines
* Collaborative team player — works effectively in an offshore delivery model with onsite and P4 colleagues
* Comfortable asking for help and working under senior guidance without needing full autonomy

**Technical Skills**

* Hands on experience in database connectivity, SQL Server / Dev, Oracle, Snowflake, Netezza, both on-prem and in cloud. And familiarity with ETL and data virtualization tools.
* Experience in MDM/360, API
* Good Knowledge or experience in Python, AI / ML , Data visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field with 7-10 years’ experience
* Exposure to banking or financial services data environments
* Familiarity with Agile delivery — experience attending stand-ups, sprint reviews, or retrospectives
* Exposure to data reconciliation tasks in a reporting or analytics context
* Interest in or awareness of data governance, data cataloguing, or MDM frameworks

**What Good Looks Like in This Role**
**.**

* Data validation - Runs checks, logs results, flags mismatches

Root cause is unclear, or impact is high
  
  

* Reconciliation- Executes reconciliation steps, documents findings

Unexplained volume differences or systemic breaks
  
  

* Requirements - Takes notes, drafts user stories, checks completeness

Conflicting requirements or scope ambiguity
  
  

* Defect logging - Logs full defect detail, retests fixes

Defect is disputed or requires architectural decision
  
  

* UAT - Execute test cases, logs results

Business sign-off decisions or critical failures
  
  

* SQL queries- Writes and runs validation queries with guidance

Complex multi-system queries or performance issues
  
  
**Key Success Measures**

* Accuracy and completeness of data validation outputs and reconciliation documentation
* Quality of defect logs — clear, reproducible, and fully evidenced
* Timely escalation of data issues and discrepancies to P4 leads
* Reliable completion of assigned UAT test cases within sprint or release timelines
* Growing confidence and independence in SQL-based validation and data analysis tasks over time
* Positive feedback from Senior Leads on quality of support and documentation

**Role Positioning at a Glance**

* Primary Focus: Data validation, reconciliation support, and requirements documentation across MDM consumption workstreams
* Analyst — Not Developer: Interprets, documents, and validates data flows — does not build pipelines or write production code
* Key Strength: Attention to detail + growing MDM data knowledge + structured documentation and communication
* Supports: MDM Team, Senior, Juniors MDM Analysts and Product Lead across all consumption, Data Quality, Remediation and reporting workstreams

**Relationships & Collaboration**

* Reports to: Senior MDM Lead / Data Management Leadership
* Partners: Data Engineering, Operational/Reporting Teams, Data Stewards, Business Stakeholders, Senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

**Accessibility Needs**
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.
