We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.**

description: DescriptionAmazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the comprehensive e-commerce product catalog. We power the online shopping experience for customers worldwide, enabling them to find, discover, and purchase anything they desire. Our scaled, distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates across billions of products, including physical, digital, and service offerings.You will be part of Catalog Support Programs (CSP) team under Catalog Support Operations (CSO) in ASCS Org. CSP provides program management, technical support, and strategic initiatives to enhance the customer experience, owning the implementation of business logic and configurations for ASCS. We are establishing a new centralized Business Intelligence team to build self-service analytical products for ASCS that provide relevant insights and data deep dives across the business. By leveraging advanced analytics and AI/ML, we will transform catalog data into predictive insights, helping prevent customer issues before they arise. Real-time intelligence will support proactive decision-making, enabling faster, data-driven decisions across the organization and driving long-term growth and an enhanced customer experience.We are looking for a creative and goal-oriented BI Engineer to join our team to harness the full potential of data-driven insights to make informed decisions, identify business opportunities and drive business growth.This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, knowledge of business intelligence solutions, as well as business acumen and the ability to work with various tech/product teams across ASCS. This role will involve collaborating with business and tech leaders within ASCS and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. for building a structured analytical data layer, bringing in BI discipline by defining metrics in a standardized way and establishing a single definition of metrics across the catalog ecosystem. This team will leverage advanced analytics that can shift us to a proactive, data-driven approach, enabling informed decisions that drive growth and enhance the customer experience. title: Staff Engineer, Silicon & Data Automation Systems (Design, DFT, Diagnostics, Yield)
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering
  
  
**General Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong
**Staff Engineer, Silicon & Data Automation Systems**
to help build and expand a growing automation team supporting silicon and system yield engineering, spanning design, DFT, diagnostics, and yield engineering workflows. This role will focus on developing production-grade automation, data pipelines, database-backed applications, and engineering tools that improve the speed, quality, and scalability of complex semiconductor engineering workflows.
  
  
This position is part of a broader effort to increase automation capacity within the silicon engineering organization, beginning with new engineering roles in the Bangalore Design Center (BDC). The engineer will work closely with U.S.-based yield automation leadership and stakeholders, including regular overlap with U.S. Central Time morning hours.
  
  
This is a
**senior individual contributor role**
. The successful candidate will build new automation capabilities under architectural guidance, contribute to robust production systems, and use modern AI-assisted engineering practices to increase development velocity and quality. This role requires an
**AI-first engineering mindset**
, where LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools are used as core productivity multipliers while maintaining strong human ownership of correctness, security, review, and production safety.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong Linux, data, database, and automation engineer who can work effectively in complex semiconductor engineering environments. Prior experience with semiconductor engineering domains such as silicon design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, or yield is strongly preferred but not required for candidates with strong automation and data engineering depth.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
  
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Automation Development & Production Engineering**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain automation tools that improve silicon and system yield engineering workflows, including data processing, diagnostics, reporting, and operation efficiency.
* Build reliable Linux-based automation services, scripts, data loaders, and backend systems used by engineering teams.
* Develop production-grade solutions with appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, alerting, documentation, and operational supportability.
* Contribute to systems that are maintainable, fault-tolerant, secure, and suitable for long-running production use.
* Debug and resolve automation issues across Linux servers, databases, file systems, scheduled jobs, data feeds, and dependent engineering systems.
* Work under architectural guidance to implement new automation capabilities while developing deeper ownership of specific tools, workflows, or data domains over time.

**Data Systems & Database Automation**

* Build and maintain data pipelines that collect, transform, validate, and load engineering and manufacturing data across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and yield-related systems.
* Work with relational databases, SQL, schema design, query optimization, and database-backed automation workflows.
* Integrate data from multiple sources, including engineering systems, manufacturing data feeds, logs, reports, and analysis outputs.
* Develop tools that make complex data easier to access, validate, monitor, and act upon.
* Ensure data quality, traceability, and operational robustness in automation that supports engineering analysis and decision-making.

**AI-Assisted Engineering & Automation Acceleration**

* Use LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools responsibly as part of day-to-day engineering work.
* Apply AI-assisted development practices to improve code quality, accelerate troubleshooting, generate tests, improve documentation, and increase engineering output.
* Build or integrate AI-enabled engineering tools where appropriate, including automation agents, internal assistants, MCP servers, and workflow accelerators.
* Maintain strong human review and engineering judgment for AI-generated code, SQL, analysis, documentation, and operational recommendations.
* Ensure AI-assisted workflows follow appropriate standards for security, correctness, maintainability, and production safety.
* Help establish practical patterns for using AI-first development methods in production engineering environments.

**Tooling, Applications & Workflow Integration**

* Build backend tools, dashboards, web applications, APIs, command-line utilities, and scheduled automation to support engineering needs.
* Use appropriate technologies for the problem, including Python, shell scripting, SQL, Django or similar frameworks, REST APIs, log analytics tools, and enterprise data systems.
* Integrate automation into existing engineering workflows without disrupting production operations.
* Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to identify manual pain points and convert them into reliable automated solutions.
* Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and operational notes so tools can be supported and extended over time.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineers across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and data domains to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.
* Communicate technical findings, implementation options, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both software-oriented and semiconductor engineering audiences.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, troubleshooting sessions, and production readiness reviews.
* Collaborate effectively across time zones, including regular overlap with U.S. Central Time morning hours.
* Contribute to a growing team culture focused on engineering rigor, accountability, automation leverage, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based development and automation, including shell scripting, server-side troubleshooting, cron or scheduled jobs, file systems, permissions, and operational debugging.
* Strong programming skills in Python or a comparable language used for automation, data processing, backend systems, or engineering tools.
* Strong experience with SQL, relational databases, data modeling, query development, and database-backed applications.
* Experience building automation that processes, validates, transforms, or integrates large technical datasets.
* Experience developing production-quality software or automation with testing, logging, error handling, documentation, and maintainability.
* Experience using Git or similar version control systems in a collaborative environment.
* Practical experience using LLM-based coding agents or AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity.
* Ability to review AI-generated work critically and maintain ownership of correctness, security, reliability, and production readiness.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across software, data, database, and Linux environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders with required time overlap.

**Additional Consideration**

* Candidates with strong software, data, or automation backgrounds from non-semiconductor domains will be considered if they demonstrate the ability to learn complex engineering workflows quickly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with semiconductor design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, yield, or product engineering environments.
* Experience working with engineering datasets such as test data, DFT outputs, manufacturing data, diagnostic data, or high-volume silicon or system telemetry.
* Familiarity with semiconductor data formats such as STDF, KLARF, wafer maps, lot history, test results, binning, dispositions, or assembly data.
* Experience building automation for engineering teams in semiconductor, manufacturing, hardware, or similar domains.
* Experience with Oracle, PL/SQL, ODBC, database loaders, schema design, or production database integration.
* Experience with Django or similar backend frameworks.
* Experience with REST APIs, internal tools, dashboards, reporting systems, or workflow applications.
* Experience with log analytics, monitoring, Splunk, or observability tools.

title: Senior NetSuite Administrator
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior NetSuite Administrator to own the health, performance, and evolution of our NetSuite ERP environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who can serve as the go-to expert across finance/ERP configuration, customizations, and integrations — balancing day-to-day system administration with strategic projects that scale the platform alongside the business. * Support adjacent Finance Systems including Stripe, Zip, Anrok, Ramp, Navan, Workato, and related enterprise applications.

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of hands-on NetSuite administration experience, including at least 2+ years in a senior, lead, or solution-architect capacity
* Strong proficiency in SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk/REST web services, and SuiteBuilder
* Deep understanding of core NetSuite ERP modules: GL, AP/AR, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, and Multi-book/Multi-currency
* Experience with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management
* Ability to breakdown stakeholder requirements to technical solutions that are robust and scalable
* Proven experience designing and supporting integrations with third-party systems (CRM, payroll, EDI, e-commerce, banking, etc.)
* Experience managing multi-subsidiary, multi-currency, and/or OneWorld NetSuite environments a strong plus
* Solid grasp of accounting and finance fundamentals (GAAP) sufficient to partner effectively with Finance stakeholders
* Experience with data migration, ETL tools, and middleware platforms (Celigo, Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or similar)
* Track record of managing NetSuite release testing, sandbox refreshes, and production deployments
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with non-technical stakeholders
* NetSuite certifications (e.g., SuiteFoundation, ERP Consultant, SuiteCloud Developer) preferred
* Experience in a SOX-compliant or audited environment
* Familiarity with adjacent tools such as Stripe, Salesforce, Anrok, or ADP - Plus
* Prior experience supporting a company through an ERP implementation, M&A integration, or platform migration - Plus

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Role Description**
**Why Join 7-Eleven Global Solution Center?**
When you join us, you'll embrace ownership as teams within specific product areas take responsibility for end-to-end solution delivery, supporting local teams and integrating new digital assets. Challenge yourself by contributing to products deployed across our extensive network of convenience stores, processing over a billion transactions annually. Build solutions for scale, addressing the diverse needs of our 84,000+ stores in 19 countries. Experience growth through cross-functional learning, encouraged and applauded at 7-Eleven GSC. With our size, stability, and resources, you can navigate a rewarding career. Embody leadership and service as 7-Eleven GSC remains dedicated to meeting the needs of customers and communities.
  
  
**Why We Exist, Our Purpose and Our Transformation?**
7-Eleven is dedicated to being a customer-centric, digitally empowered organization that seamlessly integrates our physical stores with digital offerings. Our goal is to redefine convenience by consistently providing top-notch customer experiences and solutions in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. Anticipating customer preferences, we create and implement platforms that empower customers to shop, pay, and access products and services according to their preferences. To achieve success, we are driving a cultural shift anchored in leadership principles, supported by the realignment of organizational resources and processes.
  
  
At 7-Eleven we are guided by our
**Leadership Principles**
. Each principle has a defined set of behaviours which help guide the 7-Eleven GSC team to Serve Customers and Support Stores.
  
  

* Be Customer Obsessed
* Be Courageous with Your Point of View
* Challenge the Status Quo
* Act Like an Entrepreneur
* Have an “It Can Be Done” Attitude
* Do the Right Thing
* Be Accountable

**About This Opportunity**
**Job Title:**
Lead Data Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of overall IT experience with a strong focus on Data Warehousing and Data Lake solutions.
* Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale Data Warehouse and DataLake architectures.
* Strong experience working with cloud-based database platforms in AWS and/or Azure environments.
* 4+ years of experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL database administration, development, and performance optimization.
* Experience with MongoDB, Document DB, or other document-oriented databases.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of Data Warehouse modeling concepts, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, dimensional modeling, and data governance best practices.
* Strong expertise in SQL query tuning, performance optimization, indexing strategies, partitioning, and database troubleshooting.
* Solid understanding of database infrastructure, scalability, high availability, backup/recovery, security, and capacity planning.
* Experience designing and implementing standardized database frameworks, governance models, and best practices across enterprise platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Liquibase or similar tool for database version control, schema deployment, and change management.
* Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines for database and data platform deployments using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar.
* Experience with cloud-native database services on AWS and/or Azure.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience defining enterprise database standards, reusable frameworks, and automation processes.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates, etc.) is a plus.
* Experience working with large-scale data platforms supporting analytics and reporting workloads.
* Understanding of database monitoring, observability, and cost optimization in cloud environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive database modernization and standardization initiatives.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Nice to Have
* AWS and/or Azure Cloud Certifications.

As the recognized leader in convenience, the 7-Eleven family of brands embraces diversity, equity and inclusion (DE+I). It’s not only the right thing to do for customers, Franchisees and employees—it’s a business imperative.

offers a comprehensive benefits plan tailored to meet the needs and improve the overall experience of our employees, aiding in the management of both their professional and personal aspects.

Encouraging employees to unwind, recharge, and find balance, we offer flexible and hybrid work schedules along with diverse leave options. Supplementary allowances and compensatory days off are provided for specific work demands.

Additionally, an Employee Assistance Program with free, unbiased and confidential expert consultations for personal and professional issues.

Support and reimbursement for newly hired employees relocating to Bangalore, India.

title: Oracle PAAS Admin Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle PAAS Admin - Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a Cloud Technical Consultant within Managed Services, you will support clients in maintaining, enhancing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions that enable business performance and operational continuity. Deloitte’s practitioners bring together technology experience, process knowledge, and delivery discipline to help organizations address complex operational needs, improve system performance, and support ongoing transformation in a dynamic business environment.
  
  
Level: Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Support Oracle Cloud technical operations across managed services engagements, including issue analysis, defect resolution, and system enhancements.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, extensions, and data conversion components using Structured Query Language (SQL), BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File-Based Data Import templates.
* Support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Service-Oriented Architecture Cloud, Representational State Transfer services, Simple Object Access Protocol services, and Web Services Description Language-based services.
* Perform production support activities, including queue monitoring, ticket updates, incident and problem management, and resolution within service-level requirements.
* Collaborate with functional and technical teams across delivery locations to support deployments, code migrations, testing, and ongoing system improvements.

**The team**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or Information Systems.
* 3-6 years of experience in Oracle Middleware, Oracle Fusion administration, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Oracle Platform as a Service administration.
* Experience configuring or administering Oracle Platform as a Service tools, including Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Service-Oriented Architecture Cloud, Visual Builder, Oracle API Gateway, Autonomous Transaction Processing, Autonomous Data Warehouse, or Oracle Database Cloud Service.
* Experience configuring or supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services, including Virtual Cloud Networks, subnets, Identity and Access Management policies, platform monitoring, and access controls.
* Experience provisioning, patching, upgrading, or maintaining cloud environments across development, testing, and production stages.
* Experience automating administrative tasks with Terraform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Command Line Interface, Linux or Unix shell scripting, or Python.
* Experience troubleshooting cloud environment errors, managing Oracle Service Requests, or supporting application deployments and connectivity setup.

Preferred:
  
  

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024 Foundations Associate certification, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certified Associate certification, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certified Professional certification.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: Cloud Migration Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Oracle Database Architecture
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Oracle GoldenGate
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current systems and infrastructure to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes strategizing and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and optimized for performance. The position requires close collaboration with various teams to align migration efforts with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced operational capabilities and improved business outcomes.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless migration and integration of applications and data.
* Monitor and troubleshoot migration processes to maintain high availability and performance.
* Document migration plans, processes, and outcomes to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support during migration activities.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Database Architecture.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Oracle GoldenGate.
* Strong knowledge of cloud migration strategies and best practices.
* Familiarity with private and public cloud platforms and their architectures.
* Ability to analyze and optimize database performance in cloud environments.
* Experience with data replication and synchronization techniques.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Oracle Database Architecture.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: PowerBI Administartor
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting
  
  
Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  
  
Min Experience: 6+ years
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
  
JobType: full-time
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
We are seeking a Staff Power BI Engineer to join our Analytics and BICOE team. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for the architecture, administration, and strategic enablement of the Power BI and ThoughtSpot platforms across the organization. The ideal candidate will drive platform administration, scalability, governance, report development, and adoption, while partnering closely with engineering, data, and business teams to enable data-driven decision-making at scale. This role owns the end-to-end analytics experience, with a strong emphasis on Power BI platform administration, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GCP BigQuery (BQ), cloud-native architecture, and high-performance SQL, enabling scalable, governed, and reliable analytics across Albertsons. Please note: This is primarily a Power BI administrator role, with Power BI development and ThoughtSpot administration, development skills considered a strong plus.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* 5–8 years of experience in data analytics, with expert-level skills in Power BI administration and Power BI Report development
* Own the end-to-end administration, governance, and operations of the Power BI platform, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and performance
* Administer and manage Power BI tenant settings, licensing models, workspaces, and Premium capacities
* Monitor and troubleshoot Power BI Premium capacity utilization and performance using the Premium Capacity Metrics app and related tools
* Design, install, configure, and manage Power BI Gateways and enterprise data connections
* Troubleshoot and resolve Power BI ecosystem issues, including report access failures, dataset and dataflow refresh issues, gateway connectivity problems, and service disruptions
* Develop Power BI reports and semantic models based on business requirements
* Debug and optimize Power BI report and semantic model performance using Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and other third-party tools; provide recommendations to report developers
* Automate platform administration, monitoring, and governance using PowerShell or Python and Power BI REST APIs
* Configure and manage Power BI Copilot tenant settings, feature flags, and capacity prerequisites; establish enterprise guardrails and best practices for Copilot usage including dataset readiness, semantic model quality, and user enablement
* Monitor Power BI Copilot adoption, usage patterns, and platform impact, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Enforce security and governance standards, including workspace controls and role-based access at scale

title: Specialist - SAP Basis
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
Join Novonesis as an SAP Basis Specialist and help ensure the reliability of the SAP platforms that support our ability to produce and distribute our products. You will become part of an experienced five-person SAP Basis team responsible for two legacy SAP platforms as well as the SAP infrastructure and Basis workstream for our SAP S/4HANA project.
  
  
The role & your impact
  
  
In this role, your primary focus will be operational reliability across our SAP landscape. Alongside day-to-day execution, you will help optimize how we operate through automation, improved monitoring, standardization and lifecycle management. You will also contribute to our SAP S/4HANA project and help establish the future operations and maintenance model.
  
  
Your key responsibilities in this role
  
  
Ensure SAP system availability, stability and performance by administering SAP RISE Private Cloud environments, monitoring system health, managing capacity and resolving incidents and technical problems.
  
  
Manage the technical lifecycle of SAP systems, including configuration, kernel updates, support packages, SAP Notes, upgrades, system copies, refreshes, migrations and technical conversions across environments.
  
  
Coordinate SAP RISE services and operational dependencies, acting as a technical interface between Novonesis, SAP, internal IT teams, application owners and external partners.
  
  
Maintain SAP security, compliance and controlled change management through secure technical configurations, user and certificate administration, vulnerability remediation, documented changes and reliable transport and release processes.
  
  
Drive automation and continuous improvement by enhancing monitoring, alerting, housekeeping, operational reporting, standardization and repeatable cloud-based SAP operating processes.
  
  
What you'll need to be successful in this role
  
  
Solid hands-on experience with SAP Basis and SAP HANA.
  
  
Understanding of SAP RISE with SAP Private Cloud Edition, including the division of responsibilities between SAP and the customer.
  
  
Experience managing incidents, service requests, maintenance activities and operational dependencies in collaboration with SAP.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify root causes and resolve complex SAP Basis, HANA, performance, connectivity and cloud-related issues.
  
  
A structured approach to operational reliability, with the ability to prioritize, take ownership and collaborate effectively with internal teams, business stakeholders and external partners.
  
  
**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**
An interest in continuously improving monitoring, documentation, standardization and operational processes.
  
  
A drive to identify repetitive activities that can be automated and establish reliable, repeatable ways of working.
  
  
Interest in cloud-based operating practices, scripting, automation and improved tooling.
  
  
What we offer you
  
  
An opportunity to join an experienced SAP Basis team responsible for business-critical SAP platforms and contribute directly to the SAP S/4HANA project. You will work across SAP, internal IT teams, functional teams, developers, integration specialists, application owners and business stakeholders while helping shape our future SAP operations and maintenance model.
  
  
Working conditions
  
  
This position is based in Bangalore and follows a hybrid working model. Standard working hours apply, with occasional travel.
  
  
Application deadline
  
  
26 October 2026.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to document and share knowledge with colleagues.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion modules, interface tables, and data mapping logic.
* Proven troubleshooting ability and a methodical approach to report optimization and validation.
* Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub), CI/CD processes, and technical design documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.

This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. #BetterDaysStartNow

procedures. Familiarity with batch upload processes, automation of uploads is preferred. Experience with custom function programming in Rave is a plus.
  
  
Clinical Reporting: Expertise with SQL and / or advanced query development tools. Experience in creating clinical operational reports and dashboards from clinical data warehouse is expected. Experience with databricks is a plus

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

title: Senior Databricks Engineer - AI & Data Platform
description:

**Pushing the Edge**
**Vantiva (Euronext Paris: VANTI)**
is a global technology leader in connectivity technologies. For over 130 years, we have delivered solutions that connect what matters most. Today, we continue to redefine connectivity with industry-leading broadband, video, and IoT-driven smart systems that elevate how people live, work, and connect globally.

This proficiency has positioned us as a trusted provider to leading network service providers, enterprise customers, and consumers around the world.
  
  
Our strong commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices has earned us multiple Gold and Platinum Medals from EcoVadis for environmental and social performance. These awards place us among the top 2% of organizations in our category evaluated globally.
  
  
With our headquarters in Paris and major offices in Australia, Brazil, China, India, South Korea, the United Kingdom, and the United States, we serve a diverse global customer base.
  
  
For more information, please visit vantiva.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X (Twitter).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Application Enablement: Support the development and deployment of AI-powered applications, including LLM/GenAI workflows, RAG pipelines, and integration with Mosaic AI tooling.
* Data Platform Foundation: Design, build, and maintain the core Databricks Lakehouse platform, including workspace configuration, Unity Catalog setup, cluster policies, security, and governance.
* Data Engineering: Develop and optimize production-grade data pipelines, delivering clean, reliable datasets for analytics and AI workloads.
* Solution Architecture: Evaluate requirements, produce reference architectures, and recommend patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption that align with AI use cases.
* Standards & Best Practices: Establish engineering standards for code quality, CI/CD (Databricks Asset Bundles, Repos), testing, monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with data analysts, cloud/infra teams, and business units to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in data engineering or platform engineering roles.
* 3+ years hands-on experience with Azure Databricks (workspace administration, Delta Lake, Spark, Unity Catalog).
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Databricks workspace security: Proven experience implementing and managing workspace-level security, including network security (Private Link, VNet injection, IP access lists), identity and access management, cluster policies, secrets management, and RBAC at workspace, catalog, and object levels.
* Experience building and operating production data pipelines at scale.
* Experience with Mosaic AI (AI Playground, AI Functions, Agent Framework)
* Familiarity with GenAI/LLM application patterns (RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases) is highly desirable.
* Strong communication skills, ability to produce architecture diagrams, design documents, and present trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Nice to Have**

* Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional, Gen AI Engineer Associate).
* Experience with Unity Catalog governance at enterprise scale (metastore design, data access policies, lineage, audit logging).
* Hands-on experience with SAP integration , extracting data from S/4HANA, or BW/4HANA into a Lakehouse platform.
* Experience leading or participating in data migration from SAP BW/4HANA to Databricks, including InfoProvider mapping, transformation logic re-implementation, data validation, and cutover planning.
* Exposure to AI/ML workflows: model training infrastructure, feature stores, MLflow, or equivalent MLOps tooling — and ability to prepare SAP-sourced datasets for downstream ML consumption.

**What You'll Be Part Of**

* A growing portfolio of AI initiatives ranging from predictive analytics to generative AI applications.
* Migration of legacy to Databricks Lakehouse platform that will serve as the organization's single source of truth.
* A collaborative, engineering-driven culture that values automation, quality, and continuous improvement.

We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication.
  
  
Tech Culture
  
  
We have a unique tech culture where engineers are seen as problem solvers. The engineering org is divided into multiple pods and each pod is aligned to a particular business theme. It is a culture driven by logical debates & arguments rather than authority.
  
  
At Meesho, you get to solve hard technical problems at scale as well as have a significant impact on the lives of millions of entrepreneurs. You are expected to contribute to the Solutioning of product problems as well as challenge existing solutions.
  
  
Meesho’s User Base Has Grown 4x In The Last 1 Year And We Have More Than 50 Million Downloads Of Our App. Here Are a Few Projects We Have Completed Last Year To Scale Oursystems For This Growth
  
  

* We have developed API gateway aggregators using frameworks like Hystrix and spring-cloud-gateway for circuit breaking and parallel processing.
* Our serving microservices handle more than 15K RPS on normal days and during saledays this can go to 30K RPS. Being a consumer app, these systems have SLAs of ~10ms
* Our distributed scheduler tracks more than 50 million shipments periodically fromdifferent partners and does async processing involving RDBMS.
* We use an in-house video streaming platform to support a wide variety of devices and networks.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and implement scalable and fault-tolerant data pipelines (batch and streaming) using frameworks like Apache Spark, Flink, and Kafka.
* Lead the design and development of data platforms and reusable frameworks that serve multiple teams and use cases.
* Build and optimize data models and schemas to support large-scale operational and analytical workloads.
* Deeply understand Apache Spark internals and be capable of modifying or extending the open-source Spark codebase as needed.
* Develop streaming solutions using tools like Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming.
* Drive initiatives that abstract infrastructure complexity, enabling ML, analytics, and product teams to build faster on the platform.
* Champion a platform-building mindset focused on reusability, extensibility, and developer self-service.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance through validation frameworks, observability tooling, and access controls.
* Optimize infrastructure for cost, latency, performance, and scalability in modern cloud-native environments.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers, contribute to architecture reviews, and uphold high engineering standards.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, ML, and data teams to align technical solutions with business needs.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5-8 years of professional experience in software/data engineering with a focus on distributed data systems.
* Strong programming skills in Java, Scala, or Python, and expertise in SQL.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience with big data systems including Apache Kafka, Apache Spark/EMR/Dataproc, Hive, Delta Lake, Presto/Trino, Airflow, and data lineage tools (e.g., Datahb,Marquez, OpenLineage).
* Experience implementing and tuning Spark/Delta Lake/Presto at terabyte-scale or beyond.
* Strong understanding of Apache Spark internals (Catalyst, Tungsten, shuffle, etc.) with experience customizing or contributing to open-source code.
* Familiarity and worked with modern open-source and cloud-native data stack components such as:

* Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect

* Exposure to data security, privacy, observability, and compliance frameworks is a plus.

**Good to Have**

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI
description:
**Job Description**
A.P. Moller - Maersk is an integrated container logistics company and member of the A.P. Moller Group. Connecting and simplifying trade to help our customers grow and thrive. With a dedicated team of over 80,000, operating in 130 countries; we go all the way to enable global trade for a growing world. We leverage cutting-edge technology to optimize operations, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth. We are seeking a Lead Engineer - Data & AI to join our team and play a pivotal role.
  
  
**About The Role**
Maersk moves a significant share of the world's containerized trade and is a major player in the logistics and services space. The data is large, complex and consequential. This role offers real architectural ownership of a platform that matters, with the freedom to build it yourself, within a team that treats AI tooling as a serious part of engineering practice.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who designs and builds the most critical parts of our systems. You will partner in setting the architecture for our data and AI platform, decide how the major pieces fit together, and then write and deploy the code that proves the design works. Design documents and diagrams are part of the job, but they are the beginning of the work rather than the output. The engineers who do well in this role are the ones whose designs are trusted because they have shipped the hard parts themselves.
  
  
The scope spans the full stack of a data and AI platform: storage and table formats, pipelines, services, applications, and the agentic systems built on top. You will make the calls on open standards and interoperability, on build against buy, and on how we sequence a migration without disrupting what is already running. You will also set how this organization uses agentic coding, which at this level means building the tooling and the standards that other engineers work within.
  
  
The role carries no direct reports. Influence comes from the quality of your designs, the code you ship, and the engineers who get better by working alongside you.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture for major platform components and data products, from storage layer through to the application and agent layer.
* Define target architectures and the migration paths to reach them, with attention to open standards, interoperability and long-term flexibility.
* Write and deploy production code. You will personally build the difficult components and the reference implementations others extend.
* Make build against buy decisions with clear reasoning on cost, operational load and dependency risk.
* Design the platform foundations that other teams rely on: data contracts, lineage, schema evolution, access control and cost management.
* Set the agentic engineering practice across the group, including internal tooling, MCP servers, reusable skills, evaluation harnesses and the standards for reviewing generated code.
* Take on the technical problems that are genuinely hard or genuinely ambiguous, and bring them to a working resolution.
* Raise the engineering bar through design review, code review and mentoring.
* Partner with Product, Business stakeholders and Engineering Managers on sequencing, trade-offs and technical risk.

**Core Skills:**

* Programming: Writing code to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data, often using languages like Python, R, and SQL.
* AI & Machine Learning: Creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Using Machine learning (ML), a subset of AI that uses algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data
* Data Analysis: Inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information, draw conclusions, and support decision-making
* Machine Learning Pipelines: Using automated workflows that manage the end-to-end process of training and deploying machine learning models.
* Model Deployment: Making a trained machine learning model available for use in production environments.

**Required skills:**
**Architecture and system design**

* Has designed and delivered systems that multiple teams build on, and has lived with the consequences of those decisions.
* Strong command of distributed systems fundamentals, including partitioning, consistency models, delivery guarantees, backpressure and schema evolution.
* Designs for the non-functional requirements from the start: reliability, recovery, latency, cost, security and operability.
* Has migrated live systems to a new architecture while keeping them running.
* Writes design documents that another engineer can build from without further explanation.

**Data engineering**

* Platform-level design of table formats and catalogs, covering Iceberg, Delta Lake or Hudi, along with partitioning, clustering, compaction and file layout strategy.
* Both batch and streaming architectures, including change data capture and event-driven ingestion.
* Transformation frameworks at scale, such as dbt, together with semantic layer design.
* Data modelling depth sufficient to set standards that other teams follow.
* Performance and cost tuning at platform level, including query engines, storage layout and compute sizing.
* Multi-tenant governance, data quality frameworks and lineage.

**Software engineering**

* Deep expertise in at least one language and working fluency in others.
* Service and API design, including versioning, backwards compatibility and contract management across teams.
* Observability as a design concern: instrumentation, tracing, structured logging and meaningful alerting.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or equivalent, and container orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Security practice covering authentication, authorisation, secrets management and data protection.
* Front-end capability sufficient to build a usable interface when a product needs one.

**AI and agentic engineering**

* Expert-level use of agentic coding tools. You work through agents for a large share of your output and can explain your harness, your context strategy, how you run work in parallel and how you keep quality high.
* Has built tooling that extends what agents can do, such as MCP servers, custom skills, spec-driven workflows or evaluation harnesses.
* Has taken large language model systems to production, covering retrieval design, structured output, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, and human review where it belongs.
* Clear judgement on where a model belongs in a system and where deterministic code is the better answer.
* Sets the standard for how generated code is reviewed and how agentic work is verified.

**Open source**

* Meaningful exposure to open source, whether through contributions to established projects, maintaining a project with real users, or substantial public work of your own.
* Familiarity with the open standards in this space and a considered view on interoperability.
* Public artefacts such as repositories, technical writing or conference talks are a strong signal.

We would be interested to understand from you genuine depth in a minimum two or three of above areas and strong working command across the rest.
  
  
**What makes you a strong candidate?**
Demonstrated work carries the most weight in this role. The strongest candidates can point to systems they designed and built that are running in production, and can explain the decisions behind them, including the ones they would make differently now.
  
  
Additional indicators of a strong fit:
  
  

* A track record as a Staff, Principal or Lead engineer who remained hands-on, or as an architect who still writes and deploys code.
* Experience being the technical anchor on a platform or product that other teams depended on.
* A public body of work: an active GitHub profile with substantial projects, open source contributions, technical writing or talks.
* Has introduced a significant technical change into an organisation and carried it through to adoption.
* Comfort moving between architectural thinking and detailed implementation within the same week.

Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Staff Database Administrator
description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are looking for a Staff Database Administrator to own and evolve our SQL Server database infrastructure across production and non-production environments. This senior individual contributor role within the Infrastructure and Operations team will be responsible for database availability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and long-term architectural direction. The role will support platforms including Autotask, Kaseya VSA, and our broader multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure, while serving as the primary escalation point for critical database incidents.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the day-to-day administration, maintenance, monitoring, patching, and health of SQL Server environments across production, staging, and development.
* Drive database performance optimization through query tuning, execution plan analysis, index design, statistics management, and wait statistics analysis.
* Design, implement, and operate high-availability solutions, including SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, log shipping, and failover procedures.
* Own backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies, including point-in-time recovery, log chain management, recovery validation, and regular DR failover testing.
* Partner with application development teams to manage schema migrations and database changes while maintaining data integrity across multi-tenant environments.
* Define and own the long-term SQL Server technology roadmap, including evaluating cloud database options such as Azure SQL and AWS RDS where appropriate.
* Lead database capacity planning and forecasting across storage, IOPS, compute, and database growth requirements.
* Partner with Security, AWS Cloud, and DevOps teams on database security, access controls, encryption, monitoring, and CI/CD-based database deployments, while serving as a primary escalation point for critical database incidents and participating in the on-call rotation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6 or more years of hands-on SQL Server DBA experience in production enterprise environments, with demonstrated ownership at a senior or principal level
* Deep expertise in SQL Server performance tuning: execution plans, query rewrites, index design, statistics management, and wait type analysis
* Proven experience designing and operating SQL Server high availability solutions, specifically Always On Availability Groups
* Solid understanding of SQL Server backup and recovery architectures, including point-in-time recovery, log chain management, and DR failover testing
* Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS platforms at scale, including schema versioning, tenant isolation, and database-per-tenant or shared-schema architectures
* Strong scripting ability in T-SQL and PowerShell for automation of routine DBA tasks, alerting, and maintenance
* Familiarity with cloud-hosted SQL environments including Azure SQL or AWS RDS is a meaningful advantage for this role
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in written English with a distributed team across US and India time zones
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Python scripting experience for database automation or monitoring integrations
* Familiarity with CMMC 2.0, FedRAMP, or other compliance frameworks that intersect with database security controls
* Previous experience in an MSP, SaaS, or IT management software company.

title: Database Administrator
description:
**Welcome to Natus Sensory India**
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Senior Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator is responsible for the performance, availability, security, recoverability, and operational health of enterprise database platforms. This is a hands-on senior role combining system DBA responsibilities with advanced SQL performance engineering. The DBA will identify slow and inefficient workloads, analyze execution plans and wait conditions, rewrite complex queries and stored code, tune indexing and configuration, and verify measurable improvements without compromising data integrity or application behaviour.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, configure, patch, upgrade, monitor, secure, and troubleshoot production and non-production Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Review database and instance configuration, memory, CPU, storage, I/O, parallelism, TempDB or temporary tablespaces, optimizer settings, statistics, and maintenance strategies.
* Proactively identify slow, high-cost, blocking, frequently executed, or resource-intensive SQL using platform telemetry and workload history.
* Analyze Oracle execution plans, AWR/ASH reports, SQL Monitor, wait events, session activity, and optimizer behaviour; use SQL Tuning Advisor appropriately and validate recommendations.
* Analyze SQL Server actual execution plans, Query Store, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking, deadlocks, memory grants, spills, parameter sensitivity, and plan regressions.
* Review and rewrite SQL, PL/SQL, T-SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, jobs, and batch processes to improve performance, scalability, maintainability, and correctness.
* Design and tune indexes, statistics, partitioning, query patterns, hints only when justified, and data-access strategies while controlling write, storage, and maintenance overhead.
* Establish repeatable performance baselines; document findings; test changes with representative data and workloads; compare duration, CPU, logical/physical I/O, waits, reads, plans, and concurrency before release.
* Own backup, restore, recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, replication, integrity checks, capacity planning, and recovery testing for both platforms.
* Support Oracle Data Guard/RMAN and SQL Server Always On, log shipping, Database Mail, SQL Agent, and native backup/restore technologies as applicable.
* Investigate incidents, blocking, deadlocks, failed jobs, corruption alerts, storage growth, capacity constraints, and database availability issues; complete root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Implement database security, encryption, auditing, least privilege, service-account controls, privileged-access practices, and compliant handling of PHI/PII.
* Automate repeatable DBA tasks using PowerShell, T-SQL, PL/SQL, SQL\*Plus/SQLcl, shell scripting, and source-controlled deployment processes.
* Partner with developers, architects, infrastructure, security, support, and vendors; provide code-review guidance and mentor other DBAs and engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Senior-level production DBA experience supporting both Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server in business-critical environments. Senior Oracle & SQL Server DBA
* Confidential recruiting document JOB REQUISITION | DATABASE ENGINEERING
* Expert-level SQL performance tuning and proven ability to review, rewrite, and optimize complex Oracle SQL/PL/SQL and SQL Server T-SQL.
* Deep understanding of cost-based optimization, cardinality estimation, join strategies, access paths, statistics, indexing, parameterization/bind variables, plan stability, and concurrency.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle AWR, ASH, execution plans, wait events, RMAN, Data Pump, Data Guard, and diagnostic or tuning tools.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server Query Store, execution plans, DMVs, Extended Events, wait statistics, indexing, SQL Agent, backup/restore, and Always On or log shipping.
* Strong knowledge of database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, security, backup/recovery, HA/DR, monitoring, and capacity planning.
* Ability to distinguish query, schema, statistics, configuration, infrastructure, locking, application, and data volume causes of poor performance.
* Experience tuning without relying on unverified hints or indiscriminate indexing, and ability to explain the risks and tradeoffs of each recommendation.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, change-management, communication, and technical leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Eight or more years of database administration and performance-engineering experience across Oracle and SQL Server.
* Oracle Certified Professional and/or relevant Microsoft database or Azure certification.
* Experience with SQL Server 2025 and supported standard Oracle releases, including hybrid or Azure-hosted workloads.
* Experience with Azure SQL, Managed Instance, Oracle on Azure, Linux, Windows Server, SAN/storage performance, and virtualization.
* Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT, CDC, replication, large databases, partitioning, bulk loads, and high-throughput transactional systems.
* Experience in regulated healthcare or another environment subject to HIPAA, SOC 2, PHI/PII, audit, and formal change-control requirements.

**Compensation and Benefits:**
Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
**Join Natus Sensory today.**
*Confidence in every Sense.*

* Minimal travelling: less than 5%

title: Sr Mgr Business Application
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
This is a rare opportunity to shape the architectural backbone of a global pharmaceutical leader at a moment when data and AI are redefining how medicines reach patients. As Senior Manager, you'll lead the Data Lake Operations across Teva's entire data platform — setting the direction for Databricks and Azure, designing the foundations that make AI and machine learning production-ready at scale, and establishing the data governance standards that keep it all trustworthy. You won't be executing someone else's blueprint; you'll be drawing it, working across business and technology leadership to turn a sprawling data landscape into a coherent, well-governed platform that teams actually want to build on. For a leader who wants breadth, autonomy, and visible impact — where the systems you design ultimately support better health outcomes for millions of people.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**

* Provide end-to-end engineering support across the data lifecycle, including data acquisition, organization, analysis, and delivery.
* Design scalable architectures for new data products, platform capabilities, and data solutions.
* Develop and maintain data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Python, PySpark, and SQL.
* Translate business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories into secure and reliable technical solutions.
* Own data engineering initiatives from design through production deployment, applying CI/CD, security, and operational best practices.
* Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and optimize data delivery.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Min 10+ Years Experience with Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, and data modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud data platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality practices.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with streaming and event-driven technologies, such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, and observability tools for data platforms.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL, with a good understanding of machine learning libraries.
* Proven expertise in Microsoft Azure data services, including Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Azure DevOps.
* Solid knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience implementing automated build, testing, and deployment pipelines.
* Strong understanding of API and web-service security, data security practices, and secure data engineering methods.
* Hands-on experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL, including data modeling and query optimization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and across teams.

**Also Good to Have**
**Salary Range**
**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community.  When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.

title: Principal Professional, Database Management
description:
**About Marvell**
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
  
  
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
  
  
**Your Team, Your Impact**
Corporate TechOps (Database) group is responsible for building, managing, and supporting enterprise applications, engineering databases, and associated application environments.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Plan and respond to service outages including backups and restores
* Monitor system performance and diagnose software and hardware failures to resolution
* Provide patch management and distribution capabilities to prevent new threats with minimized physical infrastructure impacts
* Provide data cleansing services, verify data integrity, and implement access controls
* Perform database configuration, monitoring, and tuning
* Provide routine maintenance including problem defect analysis and resolution, space, storage, object management, physical database layout, rollback segment management, and temporary space management
* Support logs and alerts, access rights and roles, database instance version control, new IDs, roles, authorizations, audits, locked/unlocked status, and revocation
* Perform memory usage monitoring, database parameter configuration, database resources, I/O distribution
* Ensure system health, maintenance, technical security, recovery, and basic application technical tuning
* Maintain Oracle Critical Upgrades and patch management schedules
* Supports software Development, Migration, and Integration efforts as needed
* Contribute to work plans for security analysis and recommendations.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), including 12.2.x on Oracle Database 19c
* Expertise in EBS cloning, environment refreshes, and patching, including AD/TXK, online patching (adop), RUP, and CPU/PSU
* Working knowledge of EBS application upgrades (for example, 12.1.x to 12.2.x and 12.2.x RUP upgrades), including planning, testing, cutover, and rollback
* Strong expertise in Oracle Active Data Guard (ADG) for high availability, disaster recovery, and read offloading, including switchover/failover testing
* Advanced performance tuning skills (AWR, ASH, SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning, statistics management) and support for EBS concurrent processing and workflow issues
* Experience with AWS RDS (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server), including provisioning, backup, monitoring, and failover
* Proven experience with AWS DMS for migrations and replication, including schema conversion, CDC, and data validation
* Working knowledge of MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB, including replication, clustering, and high availability
* Database security expertise, including role-based access, encryption in transit, auditing, and privileged access controls
* Experience with Okta integration (SSO/SAML/OIDC) for database-connected applications, and an understanding of Managed File Transfer (MFT) tools and related database interfaces
* Basic knowledge of AI concepts and how they can be applied to database monitoring, anomaly detection, and operational efficiency
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Shell, Python, PL/SQL). OCP and AWS Database Specialty certifications, Oracle RAC/OCI experience, and Terraform/Ansible exposure are a plus

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.
  
  
**Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements**
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**Interview Integrity**
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
  
  
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
  
  
**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**
